entries.name: IsCurWaypointGoal
entries.description: Returns whether the current navigational waypoint is the final one.

returns.description: Whether the current navigational waypoint is the final one.

entries.name: IsFacingIdealYaw
entries.description: Returns whether the NPC is facing their ideal yaw. See [NPC:SetIdealYaw](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:SetIdealYaw), [NPC:GetIdealYaw](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:GetIdealYaw) and [NPC:SetIdealYawAndUpdate](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:SetIdealYawAndUpdate).

returns.description: Whether the NPC is facing their ideal yaw.

entries.name: IsGoalActive
entries.description: Returns whether the NPC has an active goal.

returns.name: act
returns.description: Whether the NPC has an active goal or not.

entries.name: IsInViewCone
entries.description: Tests whether a position or an NPC is in the view cone of the NPC.

args.name: position
args.description: The position to test.

args.name: ent
args.description: The entity to test. Will use the entity's position.

returns.description: If the given position is in the view cone.

entries.name: IsMoveYawLocked
entries.description: Returns if the current movement is locked on the Yaw axis.

returns.description: Whether the movement is yaw locked or not.

entries.name: IsMoving
entries.description: Returns whether the NPC is moving or not.

returns.description: Whether the NPC is moving or not.

entries.name: IsRunningBehavior
entries.description: Checks if the NPC is running an **ai_goal**. ( e.g. An npc_citizen NPC following the Player. )

returns.description: Returns true if running an ai_goal, otherwise returns false.

entries.name: IsSquadLeader
entries.description: Returns whether the current NPC is the leader of the squad it is in.

returns.name: is_leader
returns.description: Whether the NPC is the leader of the squad or not.

entries.name: IsUnforgettable
entries.description: Returns the "forgettable" status for a given enemy, as set by [NPC:SetUnforgettable](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:SetUnforgettable), or by internal logic of engine NPCs.

args.name: enemy
args.description: Enemy entity to check.

returns.description: Whether the given enemy is unforgettable (`true`) or not.

entries.name: IsUnreachable
entries.description:
Returns true if the entity was remembered as unreachable. The memory is updated automatically from following engine tasks if they failed:
* TASK_GET_CHASE_PATH_TO_ENEMY
* TASK_GET_PATH_TO_ENEMY_LKP
* TASK_GET_PATH_TO_INTERACTION_PARTNER
* TASK_ANTLIONGUARD_GET_CHASE_PATH_ENEMY_TOLERANCE
* SCHED_FAIL_ESTABLISH_LINE_OF_FIRE - Combine NPCs, also when failing to change their enemy

args.name: testEntity
args.description: The entity to test.

returns.description: If the entity is reachable or not.

entries.name: LostEnemySound
entries.description: Force an NPC to play their LostEnemy sound.

entries.name: MaintainActivity
entries.description: Tries to achieve our ideal animation state, playing any transition sequences that we need to play to get there.

entries.name: MarkEnemyAsEluded
entries.description: Causes the NPC to temporarily forget the current enemy and switch on to a better one.

args.name: enemy
args.description: The enemy to mark

entries.name: MarkTookDamageFromEnemy
entries.description:
Marks the NPC as took damage from given entity.

See also [NPC:GetLastTimeTookDamageFromEnemy](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:GetLastTimeTookDamageFromEnemy).

args.name: enemy
args.description: The enemy to mark. Defaults to currently active enemy (NPC:GetEnemy)

entries.name: MoveClimbExec
entries.description:
Executes a climb move.

Related functions are [NPC:MoveClimbStart](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MoveClimbStart) and [NPC:MoveClimbStop](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MoveClimbStop).

args.name: destination
args.description: The destination of the climb.

args.name: dir
args.description: The direction of the climb.

args.name: distance
args.description: The distance.

args.name: yaw
args.description: The yaw angle.

args.name: left
args.description: Amount of climb nodes left?

returns.description: The result. See Enums/AIMR.

entries.name: MoveClimbStart
entries.description:
Starts a climb move.

Related functions are [NPC:MoveClimbExec](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MoveClimbExec) and [NPC:MoveClimbStop](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MoveClimbStop).

args.name: destination
args.description: The destination of the climb.

args.name: dir
args.description: The direction of the climb.

args.name: distance
args.description: The distance.

args.name: yaw
args.description: The yaw angle.

entries.name: MoveClimbStop
entries.description:
Stops a climb move.

Related functions are [NPC:MoveClimbExec](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MoveClimbExec) and [NPC:MoveClimbStart](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MoveClimbStart).

entries.name: MoveGroundStep
entries.description:
Similar to other `NPC:Move*` functions, invokes internal code to move the NPC to a given location.

Meant to be used within [ENTITY:OverrideMove](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/ENTITY:OverrideMove).

args.name: pos
args.description: The position we want to reach.

args.name: targetEntity
args.description: Used to test whether we hit the move target when deciding success.

args.name: yaw
args.description: Target Yaw angle at the end of the move. -1 to keep original yaw.

args.name: asFarAsCan
args.description: Whether to move as far as possible.

args.name: testZ
args.description: Also test the Z axis of the target position and NPC position to decide success.

returns.description:
Whether the movement succeeded or not.

`AIMotorMoveResult_t` enum:
* AIM_FAILED = 0
* AIM_SUCCESS = 1
* AIM_PARTIAL_HIT_NPC = 2
* AIM_PARTIAL_HIT_WORLD = 3
* AIM_PARTIAL_HIT_TARGET = 4

entries.name: MoveJumpExec
entries.description:
Executes a jump move.

Related functions are [NPC:MoveJumpStart](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MoveJumpStart) and [NPC:MoveJumpStop](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MoveJumpStop).

returns.description: The result. See Enums/AIMR.

entries.name: MoveJumpStart
entries.description:
Starts a jump move.

Related functions are [NPC:MoveJumpExec](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MoveJumpExec) and [NPC:MoveJumpStop](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MoveJumpStop).

args.name: vel
args.description: The jump velocity.

entries.name: MoveJumpStop
entries.description:
Stops a jump move.

Related functions are [NPC:MoveJumpExec](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MoveJumpExec) and [NPC:MoveJumpStart](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MoveJumpStart).

returns.description: The result. See Enums/AIMR.

entries.name: MoveOrder
entries.description:
Makes the NPC walk toward the given position. The NPC will return to the player after amount of time set by **player_squad_autosummon_time** [ConVar](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/ConVar).

Only works on Citizens (npc_citizen) and is a part of the Half-Life 2 squad system.

The NPC **must** be in the player's squad for this to work.

args.name: position
args.description: The target position for the NPC to walk to.

entries.name: MovePause
entries.description:
Pauses the NPC movement?

Related functions are [NPC:MoveStart](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MoveStart), [NPC:MoveStop](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MoveStop) and [NPC:ResetMoveCalc](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:ResetMoveCalc).

entries.name: MoveStart
entries.description:
Starts NPC movement?

Related functions are [NPC:MoveStop](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MoveStop), [NPC:MovePause](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MovePause) and [NPC:ResetMoveCalc](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:ResetMoveCalc).

entries.name: MoveStop
entries.description:
Stops the NPC movement?

Related functions are [NPC:MoveStart](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MoveStart), [NPC:MovePause](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MovePause) and [NPC:ResetMoveCalc](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:ResetMoveCalc).

entries.name: NavSetGoal
entries.description: Picks random node around given vector, around specified length, using dir as search direction start. Works similarly to [NPC:NavSetRandomGoal](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:NavSetRandomGoal), but you can decide any position you want as a search starting point rather than your NPC.

args.name: pos
args.description: The origin to calculate a path from.

args.name: length
args.description: The target length of the path to calculate.

args.name: dir
args.description: The direction in which to look for a new path end goal.

returns.description: Whether path generation was successful or not.

entries.name: NavSetGoalPos
entries.description:
Creates a path to closest node at given position. This won't actually force the NPC to move.

**NOTE**: This will call either [NPC:TaskComplete](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:TaskComplete) or [NPC:TaskFail](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:TaskFail) for the current schedule and task, forcing the current task to progress to next task or fail.


See also [NPC:NavSetRandomGoal](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:NavSetRandomGoal).

args.name: pos
args.description: The position to calculate a path to.

returns.description: Whether path generation was successful or not.

entries.name: NavSetGoalTarget
entries.description:
Set the goal target for an NPC.

This will call either [NPC:TaskComplete](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:TaskComplete) or [NPC:TaskFail](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:TaskFail) for the current schedule and task, forcing the current task to progress to next task or fail.

args.name: target
args.description: The targeted entity to set the goal to.

args.name: offset
args.description: The offset to apply to the targeted entity's position.

returns.description: Whether path generation was successful or not

entries.name: NavSetRandomGoal
entries.description: Creates a random path of specified minimum length between a closest start node and random node in the specified direction. This won't actually force the NPC to move.

args.name: minPathLength
args.description: Minimum length of path in units

args.name: dir
args.description: Unit vector pointing in the direction of the target random node

returns.description: Whether path generation was successful or not

entries.name: NavSetWanderGoal
entries.description: Sets a goal in x, y offsets for the NPC to wander to

args.name: xOffset
args.description: X offset

args.name: yOffset
args.description: Y offset

returns.description: Whether path generation was successful or not

entries.name: PickupWeapon
entries.description: Forces the NPC to pickup an existing weapon entity. The NPC will not pick up the weapon if they already own a weapon of given type, or if the NPC could not normally have this weapon in their inventory.

args.name: wep
args.description: The weapon to try to pick up.

returns.name: result
returns.description: Whether the NPC succeeded in picking up the weapon or not.

entries.name: PlaySentence
entries.description: Forces the NPC to play a sentence from scripts/sentences.txt

args.name: sentence
args.description: The sentence string to speak.

args.name: delay
args.description: Delay in seconds until the sentence starts playing.

args.name: volume
args.description: The volume of the sentence, from 0 to 1.

returns.description: Returns the sentence index, -1 if the sentence couldn't be played.

entries.name: RememberUnreachable
entries.description: Makes the NPC remember an entity or an enemy as unreachable, for a specified amount of time. Use [NPC:IsUnreachable](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:IsUnreachable) to check if an entity is still unreachable.

args.name: ent
args.description: The entity to mark as unreachable.

args.name: time
args.description: For how long to remember the entity as unreachable. Negative values will act as `3` seconds.

entries.name: RemoveIgnoreConditions
entries.description: Removes conditions to ignore for the this NPC.

args.name: conditions
args.description: Ignore conditions to remove, see Enums/COND. If omitted, removes all ignore conditions.

entries.name: ResetIdealActivity
entries.description: Resets the ideal activity of the NPC. See also [NPC:SetIdealActivity](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:SetIdealActivity).

args.name: act
args.description: The new activity. See Enums/ACT.

entries.name: ResetMoveCalc
entries.description:
Resets all the movement calculations.

Related functions are [NPC:MoveStart](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MoveStart), [NPC:MovePause](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MovePause) and [NPC:MoveStop](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MoveStop).

entries.name: RunEngineTask
entries.description:
Starts an engine task.

Used internally by the [ai_task](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/ai_task).

args.name: taskID
args.description: The task ID, see [ai_task.h](https://github.com/ValveSoftware/source-sdk-2013/blob/55ed12f8d1eb6887d348be03aee5573d44177ffb/mp/src/game/server/ai_task.h#L89-L502)

args.name: taskData
args.description: The task data.

entries.name: SelectWeapon
entries.description: Forces the NPC to switch to a specific weapon the NPC owns. See [NPC:GetWeapons](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:GetWeapons).

args.name: weapon
args.description: A classname of the weapon or a Weapon entity to switch to.

entries.name: SentenceStop
entries.description:
Stops any sounds (speech) the NPC is currently playing.

Equivalent to `Entity:EmitSound( "AI_BaseNPC.SentenceStop" )`

entries.name: SetActivity
entries.description: Sets the NPC's current activity.

args.name: act
args.description: The new activity to set, see Enums/ACT.

args.name: act
args.description: See Enums/ACT.

entries.name: SetArrivalDirection
entries.description: Sets the direction from the NPC origin to its current navigational destination.

args.name: dir
args.description: The new arrival direction.

entries.name: SetArrivalDistance
entries.description: Sets the distance to goal at which the NPC should stop moving and continue to other business such as doing the rest of their tasks in a schedule.

args.name: dist
args.description: The distance to goal that is close enough for the NPC

entries.name: SetArrivalSequence
entries.description: Sets the sequence to be played when the NPC arrives at its goal.

args.name: seq
args.description: See Entity:LookupSequence.

entries.name: SetArrivalSpeed
entries.description: Sets the arrival speed? of the NPC

args.name: speed
args.description: The new arrival speed

entries.name: SetCondition
entries.description: Sets an NPC condition.

args.name: condition
args.description: The condition index, see Enums/COND.

entries.name: SetCurrentWeaponProficiency
entries.description: Sets the weapon proficiency of an NPC (how skilled an NPC is with its current weapon).

args.name: proficiency
args.description: The proficiency for the NPC's current weapon. See Enums/WEAPON_PROFICIENCY.

entries.name: SetEnemy
entries.description: Sets the target for an NPC.

args.name: enemy
args.description: The enemy that the NPC should target

args.name: newenemy
args.description: Calls NPC:SetCondition(COND.NEW_ENEMY) if the new enemy is valid and not equal to the last enemy.

entries.name: SetExpression
entries.description: Sets the NPC's .vcd expression. Similar to [Entity:PlayScene](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity:PlayScene) except the scene is looped until it's interrupted by default NPC behavior or [NPC:ClearExpression](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:ClearExpression).

args.name: m_iszExpressionScene
args.description: The expression filepath.

returns.name: flDuration
returns.description: Default duration of assigned expression, in seconds.

entries.name: SetForceCrouch
entries.description: Forces given NPC to crouch, if it is able to do so. Only Citizens and Combine Soldiers can by default.

args.name: force
args.description: Whether to force the NPC to crouch or not. `false` clears the "force crouch" flag, but does not guarantee to force the NPC to stand back up.

entries.name: SetFOV
entries.description: Sets the Field Of View of the NPC, for use with such functions as [NPC:IsInViewCone](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:IsInViewCone). it is also used internally by the NPC for enemy detection, etc.

args.name: fov
args.description: The new FOV for the NPC in degrees.

entries.name: SetHullSizeNormal
entries.description: Updates the NPC's hull and physics hull in order to match its model scale. [Entity:SetModelScale](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity:SetModelScale) seems to take care of this regardless.

entries.name: SetHullType
entries.description: Sets the hull type for the NPC.

args.name: hullType
args.description: Hull type. See Enums/HULL

entries.name: SetIdealActivity
entries.description: Sets the ideal activity the NPC currently wants to achieve. This is most useful for custom SNPCs.

args.description: The ideal activity to set. Enums/ACT.

entries.name: SetIdealSequence
entries.description: Sets the ideal sequence the NPC currently wants to achieve. This is most useful for custom SNPCs.

args.name: sequenceId
args.description: The ideal sequence to set. Entity:LookupSequence.

entries.name: SetIdealYaw
entries.description: Sets the ideal yaw angle (left-right rotation) for the NPC. Does not actually force the NPC to start turning in that direction. See [NPC:UpdateYaw](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:UpdateYaw), [NPC:GetIdealYaw](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:GetIdealYaw) and [NPC:SetIdealYawAndUpdate](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:SetIdealYawAndUpdate).

args.name: angle
args.description: The aim direction to set, the `yaw` component.

entries.name: SetIdealYawAndUpdate
entries.description: Sets the ideal yaw angle (left-right rotation) for the NPC and forces them to turn to that angle.

args.name: angle
args.description: The aim direction to set, the `yaw` component.

args.name: speed
args.description:
The turn speed. Special values are:
* `-1` - Calculate automatically
* `-2` - Keep the previous yaw speed

entries.name: SetIgnoreConditions
entries.description: Sets conditions to ignore, which would normally interrupt an Engine-based schedule. Specified conditions will still be set, will call [ENTITY:OnCondition](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/ENTITY:OnCondition) and can be returned by [NPC:HasCondition](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:HasCondition), but they will no longer interrupt the Engine schedule.

args.name: conditions
args.description: Conditions to ignore, see Enums/COND. The table must be sequential, numerical and values must correspond to condition enums.

args.name: size
args.description: Number of conditions to include in the ignored conditions table. Set this to the size of ignored conditions table to ignore all specified conditions.

entries.name: SetLastPosition
entries.description:
Sets the last registered or memorized position for this NPC. When using scheduling, the NPC will focus on navigating to the last position via nodes.

**NOTE**: The navigation requires ground nodes to function properly, otherwise the NPC could only navigate in a small area. (https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Info_node)

args.name: position
args.description: Where the NPC's last position will be set.

entries.name: SetMaxLookDistance
entries.description: Sets NPC's max view distance. An NPC will not be able to see enemies outside of this distance.

args.name: dist
args.description: New maximum distance the NPC can see at. Default is 2048 and 6000 for long range NPCs such as the sniper.

entries.name: SetMaxRouteRebuildTime
entries.description: Sets how long to try rebuilding path before failing task.

args.name: time
args.description: How long to try rebuilding path before failing task

entries.name: SetMoveDelay
entries.description:
Sets the movement delay for given NPC.

See [NPC:GetMoveDelay](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:GetMoveDelay).

args.name: delay
args.description: The amount of time in seconds to delay movement by.

entries.name: SetMoveInterval
entries.description: Sets the timestep the internal NPC motor is working on.

args.name: time
args.description: The new timestep.

entries.name: SetMovementActivity
entries.description: Sets the activity the NPC uses when it moves.

args.name: activity
args.description: The movement activity, see Enums/ACT.

entries.name: SetMovementSequence
entries.description:
Sets the sequence the NPC navigation path uses for speed calculation. Doesn't seem to have any visible effect on NPC movement or actively playing sequence.
	
To be able to use this, first set [NPC:SetIdealActivity](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:SetIdealActivity) to `ACT_DO_NOT_DISTURB`, set this to any sequence with root motion data and call [Entity:SetSequence](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity:SetSequence) on your desired sequence. As long as your NPC's [NPC:GetMovementSequence](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:GetMovementSequence) has root motion data, your NPC will move to navigation point even though your NPC's [Entity:GetSequence](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity:GetSequence) doesn't have any motion.

args.name: sequenceId
args.description: The movement sequence index

entries.name: SetMoveVelocity
entries.description: Sets the move velocity of the NPC

args.name: vel
args.description: The new movement velocity.

entries.name: SetMoveYawLocked
entries.description: Sets whether the current movement should locked on the Yaw axis or not.

args.name: lock
args.description: Whether the movement should yaw locked or not.

entries.name: SetNavType
entries.description: Sets the navigation type of the NPC.

args.name: navtype
args.description: The new nav type. See Enums/NAV.

entries.name: SetNPCState
entries.description: Sets the state the NPC is in to help it decide on a ideal schedule.

args.name: state
args.description: New NPC state, see Enums/NPC_STATE

entries.name: SetSchedule
entries.description: Sets the NPC's current schedule.

args.name: schedule
args.description: The NPC schedule, see Enums/SCHED.

entries.name: SetSquad
entries.description:
Assigns the NPC to a new squad. A squad can have up to 16 NPCs. NPCs in a single squad should be friendly to each other.

See also [ai.GetSquadMembers](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/ai.GetSquadMembers) and [NPC:GetSquad](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:GetSquad).

NPCs within the same squad are meant to function more effectively, tactics wise.

args.name: name
args.description: The new squad name to set. Do not provide this argument to reset the squad.

entries.name: SetStepHeight
entries.description:
Sets the SNPC step height.

**NOTE**: This only works for [scripted NPCs](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Scripted_Entities).

args.name: height
args.description: The new step height. Default is 18 Hammer Units.

entries.name: SetTarget
entries.description: Sets the NPC's target. This is used in some engine schedules.

args.name: entity
args.description: The target of the NPC.

entries.name: SetTaskStatus
entries.description: Sets the status of the current task.

args.name: status
args.description: The status. See Enums/TASKSTATUS.

entries.name: SetUnforgettable
entries.description: Sets given entity as an unforgettable enemy. The state can be retrieved via [NPC:IsUnforgettable](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:IsUnforgettable).

args.name: enemy
args.description: The enemy entity to set.

args.name: set
args.description: The entity to set.

entries.name: SetViewOffset
entries.description:
Sets the view offset of the NPC. Player alternative of [Player:SetViewOffset](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetViewOffset).

This affects NPC's [NPC:GetShootPos](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:GetShootPos).

args.description: The view offset to set.

entries.name: StartEngineTask
entries.description: Forces the NPC to start an engine task, this has different results for every NPC.

args.name: task
args.description: The id of the task to start, see [ai_task.h](https://github.com/ValveSoftware/source-sdk-2013/blob/55ed12f8d1eb6887d348be03aee5573d44177ffb/mp/src/game/server/ai_task.h#L89-L502)

args.name: taskData
args.description: The task data as a float, not all tasks make use of it.

entries.name: StopMoving
entries.description: Resets the NPC's movement animation and velocity. Does not actually stop the NPC from moving.

args.name: immediate
args.description: Whether to stop moving even when currently active goal doesn't want us to.

entries.name: TargetOrder
entries.description:
Cancels [NPC:MoveOrder](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:MoveOrder) basically.

Only works on Citizens (npc_citizen) and is a part of the Half-Life 2 squad system.

The NPC **must** be in the player's squad for this to work.

args.name: target
args.description: Must be a player, does nothing otherwise.

entries.name: TaskComplete
entries.description:
Marks the current NPC task as completed.

This is meant to be used alongside [NPC:TaskFail](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:TaskFail) to complete or fail custom Lua defined tasks. ([Schedule:AddTask](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Schedule:AddTask))

entries.name: TaskFail
entries.description:
Marks the current NPC task as failed.

This is meant to be used alongside [NPC:TaskComplete](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:TaskComplete) to complete or fail custom Lua defined tasks. ([Schedule:AddTask](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Schedule:AddTask))

args.name: failReason
args.description: Fail reason to be passed onto ENTITY:OnTaskFailed. The fail reason can also be seen when the NPC's `ent_text` is active.

entries.name: UpdateEnemyMemory
entries.description: Force the NPC to update information on the supplied enemy, as if it had line of sight to it.

args.name: enemy
args.description: The enemy to update.

args.name: pos
args.description: The last known position of the enemy.

entries.name: UpdateTurnActivity
entries.description: Updates the turn activity. Basically applies the turn animations depending on the current turn yaw.

entries.name: UpdateYaw
entries.description: Forces the NPC to turn to their ideal yaw angle. See [NPC:SetIdealYaw](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:SetIdealYaw) and [NPC:SetIdealYawAndUpdate](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/NPC:SetIdealYawAndUpdate).

args.name: speed
args.description:
The turn speed. Special values are:
* `-1` - Calculate automatically
* `-2` - Keep the previous yaw speed

entries.name: UseActBusyBehavior
entries.description: **NOTE**: This function only works on `ai` type [SENTs](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Scripted_Entities).

returns.description: If we succeeded setting the behavior.

entries.name: UseAssaultBehavior
entries.description:
Enables the AI's [Assault Behavior](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Assault "Assault Behavior") when an `ai_goal_assault` is set for this SENT. 
**NOTE**: This function only works on `ai` type [SENTs](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Scripted_Entities).

returns.description: Whether the action succeeded.

entries.name: UseFollowBehavior
entries.description: **NOTE**: This function only works on `ai` type [SENTs](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Scripted_Entities).

returns.description: If we succeeded setting the behavior.

entries.name: UseFuncTankBehavior
entries.description:
Orders the SNPC to control any nearby `func_tank`s looking for an NPC to operate itself, if available. 
**NOTE**: This function only works on `ai` type [SENTs](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Scripted_Entities).

returns.description: Whether the action succeeded.

entries.name: UseLeadBehavior
entries.description:
Enables the AI's [Lead Behavior](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/ai_goal_lead "Lead Behavior") when an `ai_goal_lead` is set for this SENT. 
**NOTE**: This function only works on `ai` type [SENTs](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Scripted_Entities).

returns.description: Whether the action succeeded.

entries.name: UseNoBehavior
entries.description:
Undoes the other `Use*Behavior` functions.

**NOTE**: This function only works on `ai` type [SENTs](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Scripted_Entities).

entries.name: NPCData
entries.description:
Information about the NPC data structure, used to define spawnable NPCs for the Sandbox gamemode.

Example usage:
```
list.Set( "NPC", "npc_tf2_ghost", {
	Name = "Example NPC",
	Class = "npc_tf2_ghost",
	Category = "Nextbot"
} )
```

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The nice name of the NPC for UI display.

fields.name: Class
fields.description: Class name of the entity to spawn.

fields.name: Category
fields.description: Spawnmenu category to put the NPCinto.

fields.name: SubCategory
fields.description: Optional spawnmenu sub-category to put this NPC into.

fields.name: Weapons
fields.description: A list of weapons this NPC is typically meant to use. One will be picked on spawn at random, unless overwritten by the player.

fields.name: KeyValues
fields.description: Key-value pairs to apply to the NPC on spawn. See Entity:SetKeyValue.

fields.name: Model
fields.description: Model override for this NPC.

fields.name: SpawnFlags

entries.name: OnRequestFullUpdate
entries.description:
Called when a player requests a full update from the server.  
		Called Clientside when the Update is received or when another player requested a full update.

		**NOTE**: When this event is called the first time for a client, [net](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/net) messages will be reliably received by the client.

entries.name: date
entries.description: Returns the date/time as a formatted string or in a table.

args.name: format
args.description:
The format string.

If this is equal to `*t` or `!*t` then this function will return a Structures/DateData, otherwise it will return a string.

If this starts with an `!`, the returned data will use the UTC timezone rather than the local timezone.

See http://www.mkssoftware.com/docs/man3/strftime.3.asp for available format flags.

**Not all flags are available on all operating systems** and the result of using an invalid flag is undefined. This currently crashes the game on Windows. Most or all flags are available on OS X and Linux but considerably fewer are available on Windows. See http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/fe06s4ak.aspx for a list of available flags on Windows. Note that the **#** flags also crashes the game on Windows.

Known formats that work on all platforms:

| Format | Description | Example of the output |
|:------:|:-----------:|:---------------------:|
| `%a` | Abbreviated weekday name | `Wed` |
| `%A` | Full weekday name | `Wednesday` |
| `%b` | Abbreviated month name | `Sep` |
| `%B` | Full month name | `September` |
| `%c` | Locale-appropriate date and time | Varies by platform and language settings |
| `%d` | Day of the month [01-31] | `16` |
| `%H` | Hour, using a 24-hour clock [00-23] | `23` |
| `%I` | Hour, using a 12-hour clock [01-12] | `11` |
| `%j` | Day of the year [001-365] | `259` |
| `%m` | Month [01-12] | `09` |
| `%M` | Minute [00-59] | `48` |
| `%p` | Either `am` or `pm` | `pm` |
| `%S` | Second [00-60] | `10` |
| `%w` | Weekday [0-6 = Sunday-Saturday] | `3` |
| `%W` | Week of the year [00-53] | `37` |
| `%x` | Date (Same as `%m/%d/%y`) | `09/16/98` |
| `%X` | Time (Same as `%H:%M:%S`) | `23:48:10` |
| `%y` | Two-digit year [00-99] | `98` |
| `%Y` | Full year | `1998` |
| `%z` | Timezone | `-0300` |
| `%%` | A percent sign | `%` |

args.name: time
args.description: Time to use for the format.

entries.name: Panel
entries.description:
This is the base panel for every other [VGUI](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/vgui) panel.

It contains all of the basic methods, some of which may only work on certain VGUI elements. See also [Panel Hooks](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel_Hooks).

As their functionality is provided at the game's C/C++ level rather than by its Lua script extension, they are unfortunately unavailable for most practical purposes, however, they can still be obtained in a way similar to that provided by the [baseclass](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/baseclass) library:

```
-- Create a new panel type NewPanel that inherits all of its functionality from DLabel,
-- but has a different SetText method than DLabel does - all without the hassle of that
-- old DLabel's default text getting in the way. Fun stuff.

local PANEL = {}

function PANEL:Init()

	self:SetText_Base( "" )
	self:SetText( "Time for something different!" )

end

function PANEL:Paint( aWide, aTall )

	local TextX, TextY = 0, 0
	local TextColor = Color( 255, 0, 0, 255 )

	surface.SetFont( self:GetFont() or "default" )
	surface.SetTextColor( TextColor )
	surface.SetTextPos( TextX, TextY )
	surface.DrawText( self:GetText() )

end

-- And here we go:
PANEL.SetText_Base = FindMetaTable( "Panel" ).SetText

function PANEL:SetText( aText ) 

	self.Text = tostring( aText ) 

end

function PANEL:GetText() 

	return self.Text or "" 

end

vgui.Register( "NewPanel", PANEL, "DLabel" )
```

entries.name: AnimationThink
entries.description:
Called every frame unless the panel is not visible ([Panel:IsVisible](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:IsVisible)). Similar to [PANEL:Think](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:Think), but can be disabled by [Panel:SetAnimationEnabled](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetAnimationEnabled) as explained below.

If you are overriding this, you must call [Panel:AnimationThinkInternal](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:AnimationThinkInternal) every frame, else animations will cease to work.

If you want to "disable" this hook with [Panel:SetAnimationEnabled](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetAnimationEnabled), you must call it after defining this hook. Once disabled, a custom hook **will not** be re-enabled by [Panel:SetAnimationEnabled](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetAnimationEnabled) again - the hook will have to be re-defined.

entries.name: AnimationThinkInternal
entries.description:
**INTERNAL**: This is used internally - although you're able to use it you probably shouldn't.

This is called every frame by [PANEL:AnimationThink](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:AnimationThink).

You can do this manually using [file.Read](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/file.Read) and [util.JSONToTable](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/util.JSONToTable) to import and create a GWEN table structure from a `.gwen` file. entries.name: Center
entries.description:
Centers the panel on its parent. 

See [Panel:CenterHorizontal](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:CenterHorizontal) and [Panel:CenterVertical](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:CenterVertical) for more specialized functions.


	**NOTE**: This will center the panel using the current size of the panel, so it should be called **AFTER** setting or adjusting the size of the panel.

Take special care when using [Panel:Dock](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:Dock) as it will not update the size immediately.

You may want to use [Panel:PerformLayout](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:PerformLayout) to set positions of child panels.

args.name: posY
args.description: The vertical (y) position in pixels of the point to compare with. Local to the parent panel, or container, not the panel the function is called on.

returns.description: The linear (straight-line) distance between the specified point local to parent panel and the center of this panel object.

entries.name: Dock
entries.description:
Sets the dock type for the panel, making the panel "dock" in a certain direction, modifying it's position and size.

You can set the inner spacing of a panel's docking using [Panel:DockPadding](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:DockPadding), which will affect docked child panels, and you can set the outer spacing of a panel's docking using [Panel:DockMargin](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:DockMargin), which affects how docked siblings are positioned/sized.

You may need to use [Panel:SetZPos](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetZPos) to ensure child panels ([DTextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DTextEntry)) stay in a specific order.

**NOTE**: After using this function, if you want to get the correct panel's bounds (position, size), use [Panel:InvalidateParent](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:InvalidateParent) (use `true` as argument if you need to update immediately)

args.name: dockType
args.description: Dock type using Enums/DOCK.

entries.name: DockMargin
entries.description:
Sets the dock margin of the panel.

The dock margin is the extra space that will be left around the edge when this element is docked inside its parent element.

args.name: marginLeft
args.description: The left margin to the parent.

args.name: marginTop
args.description: The top margin to the parent.

args.name: marginRight
args.description: The right margin to the parent.

args.name: marginBottom
args.description: The bottom margin to the parent.

entries.name: DockPadding
entries.description:
Sets the dock padding of the panel.

The dock padding is the extra space that will be left around the edge when child elements are docked inside this element.

args.name: paddingLeft
args.description: The left padding to the parent.

args.name: paddingTop
args.description: The top padding to the parent.

args.name: paddingRight
args.description: The right padding to the parent.

args.name: paddingBottom
args.description: The bottom padding to the parent.

entries.name: DoModal
entries.description:
Makes the panel "lock" the screen until it is removed. All input will be directed to the given panel.

It will silently fail if used while cursor is not visible.
Call [Panel:MakePopup](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:MakePopup) before calling this function.
This must be called on a panel derived from [EditablePanel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/EditablePanel).

entries.name: DragClick
entries.description:
**INTERNAL**: This is used internally - although you're able to use it you probably shouldn't.
 Called by [Panel:DragMouseRelease](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:DragMouseRelease) when a user clicks one mouse button whilst dragging with another.

returns.description: Always returns `true`.

entries.name: DragHover
entries.description:
**INTERNAL**: This is used internally - although you're able to use it you probably shouldn't.
 Called by [dragndrop.HoverThink](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/dragndrop.HoverThink) to perform actions on an object that is dragged and hovered over another.

args.name: HoverTime
args.description: If this time is greater than 0.1, PANEL:DragHoverClick is called, passing it as an argument.

entries.name: DragHoverClick
entries.description:
Called when an object is dragged and hovered over this panel for 0.1 seconds.

This is used by [DPropertySheet](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DPropertySheet) and [DTree](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DTree), for example to open a tab or expand a node when an object is hovered over it.

args.name: hoverTime
args.description: The time the object was hovered over this panel.

entries.name: DragHoverEnd
entries.description:
**INTERNAL**: This is used internally - although you're able to use it you probably shouldn't.
 Called to end a drag and hover action. This resets the panel's [PANEL:PaintOver](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:PaintOver) method, and is primarily used by [dragndrop.StopDragging](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/dragndrop.StopDragging).

entries.name: DragMousePress
entries.description: Called to inform the [dragndrop](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/dragndrop) that a mouse button is being held down on a panel object.

args.name: mouseCode
args.description: The code for the mouse button pressed, passed by, for example, PANEL:OnMousePressed. See the Enums/MOUSE.

entries.name: DragMouseRelease
entries.description: Called to inform the [dragndrop](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/dragndrop) that a mouse button has been depressed on a panel object.

args.name: mouseCode
args.description: The code for the mouse button pressed, passed by, for example, PANEL:OnMouseReleased. See the Enums/MOUSE.

returns.description: `true` if an object was being dragged, otherwise `false`.

entries.name: DrawDragHover
entries.description:
**INTERNAL**: This is used internally - although you're able to use it you probably shouldn't.
 Called to draw the drop target when an object is being dragged across another. See [Panel:SetDropTarget](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetDropTarget).

args.name: x
args.description: The x coordinate of the top-left corner of the drop area.

args.name: y
args.description: The y coordinate of the top-left corner of the drop area.

args.name: width
args.description: The width of the drop area.

args.name: height
args.description: The height of the drop area.

entries.name: DrawFilledRect
entries.description: Draws a coloured rectangle to fill the panel object this method is called on. The colour is set using [surface.SetDrawColor](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/surface.SetDrawColor). This should only be called within the object's [PANEL:Paint](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:Paint) or [PANEL:PaintOver](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:PaintOver) hooks, as a shortcut for [surface.DrawRect](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/surface.DrawRect).

entries.name: DrawOutlinedRect
entries.description: Draws a hollow rectangle the size of the panel object this method is called on, with a border width of 1 px. The border colour is set using [surface.SetDrawColor](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/surface.SetDrawColor). This should only be called within the object's [PANEL:Paint](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:Paint) or [PANEL:PaintOver](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:PaintOver) hooks, as a shortcut for [surface.DrawOutlinedRect](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/surface.DrawOutlinedRect).

entries.name: DrawSelections
entries.description: Used to draw the magenta highlight colour of a panel object when it is selected. This should be called in the object's [PANEL:PaintOver](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:PaintOver) hook. Once this is implemented, the highlight colour will be displayed only when the object is selectable and selected. This is achieved using [Panel:SetSelectable](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetSelectable) and [Panel:SetSelected](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetSelected) respectively.

entries.name: DrawTextEntryText
entries.description:
Used to draw the text in a [DTextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DTextEntry) within a derma skin. This is usually called within the [SKIN:PaintTextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/SKIN:PaintTextEntry) skin hook.
**NOTE**: Will silently fail if any of arguments are not given.

args.name: textCol
args.description: The colour of the main text.

args.name: highlightCol
args.description: The colour of the selection highlight (when selecting text).

args.name: cursorCol
args.description: The colour of the text cursor (or caret).

entries.name: DrawTexturedRect
entries.description: Draws a textured rectangle to fill the panel object this method is called on. The texture is set using [surface.SetTexture](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/surface.SetTexture) or [surface.SetMaterial](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/surface.SetMaterial). This should only be called within the object's [PANEL:Paint](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:Paint) or [PANEL:PaintOver](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:PaintOver) hooks, as a shortcut for [surface.DrawTexturedRect](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/surface.DrawTexturedRect).

entries.name: Droppable
entries.description:
Makes this panel droppable. This is used with [Panel:Receiver](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:Receiver) to create drag and drop events.

Can be called multiple times with different names allowing to be dropped onto different receivers.

args.name: name
args.description: Name of your droppable panel

returns.description: Blank table stored on the panel itself under pnl.m_DragSlot[ name ]. Is reset every time this function is called and does not appear to be used or exposed anywhere else.

entries.name: DroppedOn
entries.description:
Called when this panel is dropped onto another panel.

Only works for panels derived from [DDragBase](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DDragBase).

args.name: pnl
args.description: The panel we are dropped onto

entries.name: EndBoxSelection
entries.description: Completes a box selection. If the end point of the selection box is within the selection canvas, mouse capture is disabled for the panel object, and the selected state of each child object within the selection box is toggled.

returns.description: Whether the end point of the selection box was within the selection canvas.

entries.name: Exec
entries.description:
**INTERNAL**: This is used internally - although you're able to use it you probably shouldn't.
 Used to run commands within a [DHTML](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DHTML) window.

args.name: cmd
args.description: The command to be run.

entries.name: Find
entries.description: Finds a panel in its children(and sub children) with the given name.

args.name: panelName
args.description: The name of the panel that should be found.

returns.description: foundPanel

entries.name: FocusNext
entries.description: Focuses the next panel in the focus queue.

entries.name: FocusPrevious
entries.description: Focuses the previous panel in the focus queue.

entries.name: GenerateExample
entries.description: Called when the panel should generate example use case / example code to use for this panel. Used in the panel opened by ``derma_controls`` or ``derma_controls_menu``(To go directly to the main menu) console command.

args.name: class
args.description: The classname of the panel to generate example for. This will be the class name of your panel.

args.name: dpropertysheet
args.description: A DPropertySheet to add your example to. See examples below.

args.name: width
args.description: Width of the property sheet?

args.name: height
args.description: Width of the property sheet?

entries.name: GetAlpha
entries.description: Returns the alpha multiplier for this panel.

returns.description: alphaMul

entries.name: GetBGColor
entries.description:
Returns the background color of a panel such as a [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText), [Label](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Label) or [DColorCube](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DColorCube).

**NOTE**: This doesn't apply to all VGUI elements and its function varies between them

returns.name: color
returns.description: The Color.

entries.name: GetBounds
entries.description:
Returns the position and size of the panel.

This is equivalent to calling [Panel:GetPos](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetPos) and [Panel:GetSize](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetSize) together.

returns.description: The x coordinate of the panel, relative to its parent's top left.
The y coordinate of the panel, relative to its parent's top left.
The width of the panel.
The height of the panel.

entries.name: GetCaretPos
entries.description: Returns the position/offset of the caret (or text cursor) in a text-based panel object.

returns.description: The caret position/offset from the start of the text. A value of `0` means the caret sits before the first character.

entries.name: GetChild
entries.description: Gets a child by its index. For use with [Panel:ChildCount](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:ChildCount).

args.name: childIndex
args.description:
The index of the child to get.

This index starts at 0, except when you use this on a [DMenu](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DMenu).

entries.name: GetChildPosition
entries.description: Gets a child object's position relative to this panel object. The number of levels is not relevant; the child may have many parents between itself and the object on which the method is called.

args.name: pnl
args.description: The panel to get the position of.

returns.description: The horizontal (x) position of the child relative to this panel object.
The vertical (y) position of the child relative to this panel object.

entries.name: GetChildren
entries.description: Returns a table with all the child panels of the panel.

returns.description: All direct children of this panel.

entries.name: GetChildrenInRect
entries.description: Returns a table of all visible, selectable children of the panel object that lie at least partially within the specified rectangle.

args.name: x
args.description: The horizontal (x) position of the top-left corner of the rectangle, relative to the panel object.

args.name: y
args.description: The vertical (y) position of the top-left corner of the rectangle, relative to the panel object.

args.name: w
args.description: The width of the rectangle.

args.name: h
args.description: The height of the rectangle.

returns.description: A table of panel objects that lie at least partially within the specified rectangle.

entries.name: GetClassName
entries.description: Returns the class name of the panel. This would be the class name of the base engine-level panel, not Lua classname. The latter is stored usually in [Panel:GetName](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetName).

returns.description: The panel's class name.

entries.name: GetClosestChild
entries.description: Returns the child of this panel object that is closest to the specified point. The point is relative to the object on which the method is called. The distance the child is from this point is also returned.

args.name: x
args.description: The horizontal (x) position of the point.

args.name: y
args.description: The vertical (y) position of the point.

returns.description: The child object that was closest to the specified point.
The distance that this child was from the point.

entries.name: GetContentAlignment
entries.description:
Returns the alignment of the text of a [Label](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Label).

**NOTE**: This function only works on [Label](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Label) panels and its derivatives.

returns.name: alignment
returns.description:
The direction of the content, based on the number pad. See Enums/ContentAlignment.

1: **bottom-left** 
2: **bottom-center** 
3: **bottom-right** 
4: **middle-left** 
5: **center** 
6: **middle-right** 
7: **top-left** 
8: **top-center** 
9: **top-right**

entries.name: GetContentSize
entries.description:
Gets the size of the content/children within a panel object.

Only works with [Label](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Label) derived panels by default such as [DLabel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DLabel).


Will also work on any panel that manually implements this method.

returns.description: The content width of the object.
The content height of the object.

entries.name: GetCookie
entries.description:
Gets the value of a cookie stored by the panel object. This can also be done with [cookie.GetString](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/cookie.GetString), using the panel's cookie name, a fullstop, and then the actual name of the cookie.

Make sure the panel's cookie name has not changed since writing, or the cookie will not be accessible. This can be done with [Panel:GetCookieName](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetCookieName) and [Panel:SetCookieName](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetCookieName).

args.name: cookieName
args.description: The name of the cookie from which to retrieve the value.

args.name: default
args.description: The default value to return if the cookie does not exist.

returns.description: The value of the stored cookie, or the default value should the cookie not exist.

entries.name: GetCookieName
entries.description: Gets the name the panel uses to store cookies. This is set with [Panel:SetCookieName](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetCookieName).

returns.description:
The name the panel uses when reading or writing cookies. The format used is as follows: 
```
panelCookieName.individualCookieName
```

entries.name: GetCookieNumber
entries.description:
Gets the value of a cookie stored by the panel object, as a number. This can also be done with [cookie.GetNumber](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/cookie.GetNumber), using the panel's cookie name, a fullstop, and then the actual name of the cookie.

Make sure the panel's cookie name has not changed since writing, or the cookie will not be accessible. This can be done with [Panel:GetCookieName](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetCookieName) and [Panel:SetCookieName](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetCookieName).

args.name: cookieName
args.description: The name of the cookie from which to retrieve the value.

args.name: default
args.description: The default value to return if the cookie does not exist.

returns.description: The number value of the stored cookie, or the default value should the cookie not exist.

entries.name: GetDock
entries.description: Returns a dock enum for the panel's current docking type.

returns.description: The dock enum for the panel. See Enums/DOCK.

entries.name: GetDockMargin
entries.description: Returns the docked margins of the panel. (set by [Panel:DockMargin](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:DockMargin))

returns.description: Left margin.
Top margin.
Right margin.
Bottom margin.

entries.name: GetDockPadding
entries.description: Returns the docked padding of the panel. (set by [Panel:DockPadding](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:DockPadding))

returns.description: Left padding.
Top padding.
Right padding.
Bottom padding.

entries.name: GetFGColor
entries.description:
Returns the foreground color of the panel.

For a [Label](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Label) or [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText), this is the color of its text.

**NOTE**: This doesn't apply to all VGUI elements (such as [DLabel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DLabel)) and its function varies between them

returns.name: color
returns.description: The Color.

entries.name: GetFont
entries.description:
Returns the name of the font that the panel renders its text with.

This is the same font name set with [Panel:SetFontInternal](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetFontInternal).

**NOTE**: Only works on [Label](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Label) and [TextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/TextEntry) and their derived panels by default (such as [DLabel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DLabel) and [DTextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DTextEntry)), and on any panel that manually implemented the [Panel:GetFont](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetFont) method.

returns.description: The font name.

entries.name: GetHTMLMaterial
entries.description: Returns the panel's HTML material. Only works with [Awesomium](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Awesomium), [HTML](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/HTML) and [DHTML](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DHTML) panels that have been fully loaded.

returns.description: The HTML material used by the panel. Typically starts with `__vgui_texture_` followed by an incremental number.

entries.name: GetLineHeight
entries.description: Returns the height of a single line of a [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText) panel.

returns.description: The line height.

entries.name: GetMaximumCharCount
entries.description:
Returns the current maximum character count.

This function will only work on [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText) and [TextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/TextEntry) panels and their derivatives.

returns.name: maxChar
returns.description: The maximum amount of characters this panel is allowed to contain.

entries.name: GetName
entries.description: Returns the internal name of the panel. Can be set via [Panel:SetName](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetName).

returns.description: The previously set internal name of the panel.

entries.name: GetNumLines
entries.description:
Returns the number of lines in a [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText) or a [TextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/TextEntry).

You must wait a couple frames before calling this after using [Panel:AppendText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:AppendText) or [Panel:SetText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetText), otherwise it will return the number of text lines before the text change.

returns.description: The number of lines.

entries.name: GetParent
entries.description: Returns the parent of the panel, returns nil if there is no parent.

returns.description: The parent of given panel

entries.name: GetPos
entries.description:
Returns the position of the panel relative to its [Panel:GetParent](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetParent).

If you require the panel's position **and** size, consider using [Panel:GetBounds](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetBounds) instead.

If you need the position in screen space, see [Panel:LocalToScreen](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:LocalToScreen).

See also [Panel:GetX](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetX) and [Panel:GetY](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetY).

returns.description: X coordinate, relative to this panels parents top left corner.
Y coordinate, relative to this panels parents top left corner.

entries.name: GetScrollStartIndexes
entries.description: Returns the vertical and horizontal start indexes of a [TextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/TextEntry)'s visible text. This is useful when the panel is scrolled.

returns.name: horizontalIndex
returns.description: The horizontal start index. (characters)

returns.name: verticalIndex
returns.description: The vertical start index. (lines)

entries.name: GetSelectedChildren
entries.description: Returns a table of all children of the panel object that are selected. This is recursive, and the returned table will include tables for any child objects that also have children. This means that not all first-level members in the returned table will be of type [Panel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel).

returns.description: A table of any child objects that are selected, including tables for children of the child objects (These tables may also contain table members, as the method is recursive).

entries.name: GetSelectedTextRange
entries.description:
Returns the currently selected range of text.

This function will only work on [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText) and [TextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/TextEntry) panels and their derivatives.

returns.name: start
returns.description: The start of the range. If no text is selected it may be 0 and/or equal to the end range.

returns.name: endrange
returns.description: The end of the range. If no text is selected it may be 0 and/or equal to the start range.

entries.name: GetSelectionCanvas
entries.description:
Returns the selection canvas for this panel. This will be the first parent that has [Panel:SetSelectionCanvas](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetSelectionCanvas) set to true (or `self` if this panel is the selection canvas)

A selection canvas would be the panel that contains a bunch of selectable panels ([Panel:SetSelectable](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetSelectable)), usually for the drag'n'drop system. Calling this function on any of the selectable items, or any of their children, will return the first parent that can contain selectable panels.

returns.description: The selection canvas, otherwise `nil`.

entries.name: GetSize
entries.description:
Returns the size of the panel.

If you require both the panel's position and size, consider using [Panel:GetBounds](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetBounds) instead.

returns.description: The panel's width. (Panel:GetWide)
The panel's height (Panel:GetTall)

entries.name: GetSkin
entries.description: Returns the table for the derma skin currently being used by this panel object.

returns.description: The derma skin table currently being used by this object.

entries.name: GetTable
entries.description: Returns the internal Lua table of the panel.

returns.description: A table containing all the members of given panel object.

entries.name: GetTall
entries.description:
Returns the height of the panel.

See [Panel:GetWide](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetWide) for the width of the panel. See also [Panel:GetSize](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetSize) for a function that returns both.

returns.description: height

entries.name: GetText
entries.description:
Returns the panel's text (where applicable).

This method returns a maximum of 1023 bytes, except for [TextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/TextEntry).

returns.description: The panel's text.

entries.name: GetTextInset
entries.description: Gets the left and top text margins of a text-based panel object, such as a [DButton](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DButton) or [DLabel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DLabel). This is set with [Panel:SetTextInset](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetTextInset).

returns.description: The left margin of the text, in pixels.
The top margin of the text, in pixels.

entries.name: GetTextSize
entries.description: Gets the size of the text within a [Label](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Label) derived panel.

returns.description: The width of the text in the DLabel.
The height of the text in the DLabel.

entries.name: GetTooltip
entries.description: Returns the tooltip text that was set with [PANEL:SetTooltip](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:SetTooltip).

returns.name: tooltip
returns.description: The tooltip text, if it was set.

entries.name: GetTooltipDelay
entries.description:
Returns the tooltip delay (time between hovering over the panel, and the tooltip showing up) that was set with [Panel:SetTooltipDelay](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetTooltipDelay), or nothing if it was not set.

If the delay is not explicitly set by this function, it will fallback to the value of the `tooltip_delay` [ConVar](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/ConVar), which is `0.5` by default.

returns.name: tooltip
returns.description: The tooltip delay in seconds, if it was set.

entries.name: GetTooltipPanel
entries.description: Returns the tooltip panel that was set with [PANEL:SetTooltipPanel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:SetTooltipPanel).

returns.name: tooltip
returns.description: The tooltip panel, if it was set.

entries.name: GetValidReceiverSlot
entries.description: Gets valid receiver slot of currently dragged panel.

returns.description: The panel this was called on if a valid receiver slot exists, otherwise false.
The slot table.

entries.name: GetValue
entries.description:
Returns the value the panel holds.

In engine is only implemented for [CheckButton](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/CheckButton), [Label](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Label) and [TextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/TextEntry) as a string.

**NOTE**: This function is limited to 8092 Bytes. If using [DTextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DTextEntry), use [Panel:GetText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetText) for unlimited bytes.

returns.description: The value the panel holds.

entries.name: GetWide
entries.description:
Returns the width of the panel.

See [Panel:GetTall](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetTall) for the height of the panel. See also [Panel:GetSize](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetSize) for a function that returns both.

returns.description: width

entries.name: GetX
entries.description:
Returns the X position of the panel relative to its [Panel:GetParent](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetParent).

entries.name: InsertClickableTextEnd
entries.description: Marks the end of a clickable text segment in a [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText) element, started with [Panel:InsertClickableTextStart](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:InsertClickableTextStart).

entries.name: InsertClickableTextStart
entries.description:
Starts the insertion of clickable text for a [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText) element. Any text appended with [Panel:AppendText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:AppendText) between this call and [Panel:InsertClickableTextEnd](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:InsertClickableTextEnd) will become clickable text.

The hook [PANEL:OnTextClicked](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:OnTextClicked) is called when the text is clicked.

**NOTE**: The clickable text is a separate Derma panel which will not inherit the current font from the `RichText`.

entries.name: InsertColorChange
entries.description: Inserts a color change in a [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText) element, which affects the color of all text added with [Panel:AppendText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:AppendText) until another color change is applied.

args.name: r
args.description: The red value `(0 - 255)`.

args.name: g
args.description: The green value `(0 - 255)`.

args.name: b
args.description: The blue value `(0 - 255)`.

args.name: a
args.description: The alpha value `(0 - 255)`.

entries.name: InsertFade
entries.description:
Begins a text fade for a [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText) element where the last appended text segment is fully faded out after a specific amount of time, at a specific speed.

The alpha of the text at any given time is determined by the text's base alpha * ((`sustain` - [Global.CurTime](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Global.CurTime)) / `length`) where [Global.CurTime](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Global.CurTime) is added to `sustain` when this method is called.

args.name: sustain
args.description: The number of seconds the text remains visible.

args.name: length
args.description:
The number of seconds it takes the text to fade out.

If set **lower** than `sustain`, the text will not begin fading out until (`sustain` - `length`) seconds have passed.

If set **higher** than `sustain`, the text will begin fading out immediately at a fraction of the base alpha.

If set to **-1**, the text doesn't fade out.

entries.name: InvalidateChildren
entries.description: Invalidates the layout of this panel object and all its children. This will cause these objects to re-layout immediately, calling [PANEL:PerformLayout](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:PerformLayout). If you want to perform the layout in the next frame, you will have loop manually through all children, and call [Panel:InvalidateLayout](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:InvalidateLayout) on each.

args.name: recursive
args.description: If `true`, the method will recursively invalidate the layout of all children. Otherwise, only immediate children are affected.

entries.name: InvalidateLayout
entries.description:
Causes the panel to re-layout in the next frame. During the layout process  [PANEL:PerformLayout](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:PerformLayout) will be called on the target panel.

You should avoid calling this function every frame.

Using this on a panel after clicking on a docked element will cause docked elements to reorient themselves incorrectly. This can be fixed by assigning a unique [Panel:SetZPos](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetZPos) to each docked element.

args.name: layoutNow
args.description: If true the panel will re-layout instantly and not wait for the next frame.

entries.name: InvalidateParent
entries.description:
Calls [Panel:InvalidateLayout](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:InvalidateLayout) on the panel's [parent](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetParent). This function will silently fail if the panel has no parent.

This will cause the parent panel to re-layout, calling [PANEL:PerformLayout](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:PerformLayout).

Internally sets `LayingOutParent` to `true` on this panel, and will silently fail if it is already set.

args.name: layoutNow
args.description: If `true`, the re-layout will occur immediately, otherwise it will be performed in the next frame.

entries.name: IsLoading
entries.description:
Determines whether or not a [HTML](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/HTML) or [DHTML](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DHTML) element is currently loading a page.

**NOTE**: Before calling [Panel:SetHTML](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetHTML) or [DHTML:OpenURL](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DHTML:OpenURL), the result seems to be `false` with the Awesomium web renderer and `true` for the Chromium web renderer. This difference can be used to determine the available HTML5 capabilities.

**NOTE**: On Awesomium, the result remains `true` until the root document is loaded and when in-page content is loading (when adding pictures, frames, etc.). During this state, the HTML texture is not refreshed and the panel is not painted (it becomes invisible).

On Chromium, the value is only `true` when the root document is not ready. The rendering is not suspended when in-page elements are loading.

returns.description: Whether or not the (D)HTML object is loading.

entries.name: LerpPositions
entries.description:
Redefines the panel object's [Panel:SetPos](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetPos) method to operate using frame-by-frame linear interpolation ([Global.Lerp](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Global.Lerp)). When the panel's position is changed, it will move to the target position at the speed defined. You can undo this with [Panel:DisableLerp](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:DisableLerp).

Unlike the other panel animation functions, such as [Panel:MoveTo](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:MoveTo), this animation method will not operate whilst the game is paused. This is because it relies on [Global.FrameTime](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Global.FrameTime).

args.name: speed
args.description:
The speed at which to move the panel. This is affected by the value of `easeOut`. Recommended values are:
* **0.1 - 10** when `easeOut` is `false`.
* **0.1 - 1** when `easeOut` is `true`.

args.name: easeOut
args.description: This causes the panel object to 'jump' at the target, slowing as it approaches. This affects the `speed` value significantly, see above.

Used to load panel controls from a file.

args.name: filename
args.description: The file to open. The path is relative to garrysmod/garrysmod/.

The path used to look up the file.

* "GAME" Structured like base folder (garrysmod/), searches all the mounted content (main folder, addons, mounted games etc)
* "LUA" or "lsv" - All Lua folders (lua/) including gamesmodes and addons
* "DATA" Data folder (garrysmod/data)
* "MOD" Strictly the game folder (garrysmod/), ignores mounting.

entries.name: LocalToScreen
entries.description:
Takes X and Y coordinates relative to the panel and returns their corresponding positions relative to the screen.

See also [Panel:ScreenToLocal](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:ScreenToLocal).

**WARNING**: This function uses a cached value for the screen position of the panel, computed at the end of the last VGUI Think/Layout pass, so inaccurate results may be returned if the panel or any of its ancestors have been re-positioned outside of [PANEL:Think](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:Think) or [PANEL:PerformLayout](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:PerformLayout) within the last frame.


**NOTE**: If the panel uses [Panel:Dock](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:Dock), this function will return 0, 0 when the panel was created. The position will be updated in the next frame.

args.name: posX
args.description: The X coordinate of the position on the panel to translate.

args.name: posY
args.description: The Y coordinate of the position on the panel to translate.

returns.description: The X coordinate relative to the screen.
The Y coordinate relative to the screen.

entries.name: MakePopup
entries.description:
Focuses the panel and enables it to receive input.

This automatically calls [Panel:SetMouseInputEnabled](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetMouseInputEnabled) and [Panel:SetKeyboardInputEnabled](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetKeyboardInputEnabled(lowercase)) and sets them to `true`.

**NOTE**: Panels derived from [Panel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel) will not work properly with this function. Due to this, any children will not be intractable with keyboard. Derive from [EditablePanel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/EditablePanel) instead.

For non gui related mouse focus, you can use [gui.EnableScreenClicker](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/gui.EnableScreenClicker).

entries.name: NewAnimation
entries.description:
Creates a new animation for the panel object.

Methods that use this function:
* [Panel:MoveTo](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:MoveTo)
* [Panel:SizeTo](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SizeTo)
* [Panel:SlideUp](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SlideUp)
* [Panel:SlideDown](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SlideDown)
* [Panel:ColorTo](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:ColorTo)
* [Panel:AlphaTo](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:AlphaTo)
* [Panel:MoveBy](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:MoveBy)
* [Panel:LerpPositions](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:LerpPositions)

args.name: length
args.description: The length of the animation in seconds.

args.name: delay
args.description: The delay before the animation starts.

args.name: ease
args.description:
The power/index to use for easing.
* Positive values greater than 1 will ease in; the higher the number, the sharper the curve's gradient (less linear).
* A value of 1 removes all easing.
* Positive values between 0 and 1 ease out; values closer to 0 increase the curve's gradient (less linear).
* A value of 0 will break the animation and should be avoided.
* Any value less than zero will ease in/out; the value has no effect on the gradient.

args.name: callback
args.description:
The function to be called when the animation ends.



Function argument(s):
* table `animData` - The Structures/AnimationData that was used.
* Panel `targetPanel` - The panel object that was animated.

arguments.name: targetPanel
arguments.description: The panel object that was animated.

returns.description:
Partially filled Structures/AnimationData with the following members: 
* number **EndTime** - Equal to `length` and `delay` arguments added together, plus either the Global.SysTime if there is no other animation queued or the end time of the last animation in the queue.
* number **StartTime** - Equal to the `delay` argument, plus either the Global.SysTime if there is no other animation queued or the end time of the last animation in the queue.
* number **Ease** - Equal to the `ease` argument.
* function **OnEnd** - Equal to the `callback` argument.

entries.name: NoClipping

Sets whether this panel's drawings should be clipped within the parent panel's bounds.

To fully disable the clipping of any children see [Global.DisableClipping](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Global.DisableClipping).

We're being dropped on something
We can create a new panel here and return it, so that instead of dropping us - it drops the new panel instead! We remain where we are!

All size functions will return the new values when this hook is called.

**WARNING**: Changing the panel size in this hook will cause an infinite loop!

Instructs a HTML control to download and parse a HTML script using the passed URL.

entries.name: Paint
entries.description:
Called whenever the panel should be drawn. 

This hook will not run if the panel is completely off the screen, and will still run if any parts of the panel are still on screen.

You can create panels with a customized appearance by overriding their `Paint()` function, which will prevent the default appearance from being drawn.

See also [PANEL:PaintOver](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:PaintOver).

**NOTE**: Render operations from the [surface](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/surface) library (and consequentially the [draw](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/draw) library) are always offset by the global position of this panel, as seen in the example below

args.name: width
args.description: The panel's width.

args.name: height
args.description: The panel's height.

returns.description: Returning true prevents the background from being drawn.

entries.name: PaintAt
entries.description:
Paints a ghost copy of the panel at the given position.
		**WARNING**: This function sets Z pos of panel's children ([PANEL:SetZPos](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:SetZPos)). It also briefly unparents and reparents the panel.

args.name: posX
args.description: The x coordinate to draw the panel from.

args.name: posY
args.description: The y coordinate to draw the panel from.

entries.name: PaintManual
entries.description: Paints the panel at its current position. To use this you must call [Panel:SetPaintedManually](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetPaintedManually)(true).

args.name: unclamp
args.description: If set, overrides panels' clipping so that it can render fully when its size is larger than the game's resolution.

entries.name: PaintOver
entries.description:
Called whenever the panel and all its children were drawn, return true to override the default drawing.

This is useful to draw content over the panel without having to overwrite it's [PANEL:Paint](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:Paint) hook, for example as an indicator that a panel is selected in [PropSelect](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PropSelect)

args.name: width
args.description: The panels current width.

args.name: height
args.description: The panels current height.

returns.description: Should we disable default PaintOver rendering? This is useful in case with Derma panels that use Derma hooks.

Parents the panel to the HUD.
Makes it invisible on the escape-menu and disables controls.

**NOTE**: Tab characters will be dropped from the pasted text
