entries.name: PerformLayout
entries.description:
Called whenever the panels' layout needs to be performed again. This means all child panels must be re-positioned to fit the possibly new size of this panel.

This can be triggered in numerous ways:
* [Panel:InvalidateLayout](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:InvalidateLayout) was called this or previous frame (depending on the argument)
* [Panel:SetPos](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetPos) called more than once on the same panel ([Issue](https://github.com/Facepunch/garrysmod-issues/issues/5519))
* A child element was added to this panel (TODO: Verify me)
* The size of this panel has changed

You should not call this function directly. Use [Panel:InvalidateLayout](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:InvalidateLayout) instead.

You should also be careful to not cause layout loops. You can use `vgui_visualizelayout 1` to visualize panel layouts as they happen for debugging purposes. Panels should not be doing this every frame for performance reasons.

args.name: width
args.description: The panels current width.

args.name: height
args.description: The panels current height.

entries.name: PositionLabel
entries.description: Sets the width and position of a [DLabel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DLabel) and places the passed panel object directly to the right of it. Returns the `y` value of the bottom of the tallest object. The panel on which this method is run is not relevant; only the passed objects are affected.

args.name: lblWidth
args.description: The width to set the label to.

args.name: x
args.description: The horizontal (x) position at which to place the label.

args.name: y
args.description: The vertical (y) position at which to place the label.

args.name: lbl
args.description: The label to resize and position.

args.name: panelObj
args.description: The panel object to place to the right of the label.

returns.description: The distance from the top of the parent panel to the bottom of the tallest object (the `y` position plus the height of the label or passed panel, depending on which is tallest).

entries.name: PostAutoRefresh
entries.description:
Only works on elements defined with [derma.DefineControl](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/derma.DefineControl) and only if the panel has **AllowAutoRefresh** set to true.

Called after [derma.DefineControl](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/derma.DefineControl) is called with panel's class name.

See also [PANEL:PreAutoRefresh](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:PreAutoRefresh)

entries.name: PreAutoRefresh
entries.description:
Only works on elements defined with [derma.DefineControl](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/derma.DefineControl) and only if the panel has **AllowAutoRefresh** set to true.

Called when [derma.DefineControl](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/derma.DefineControl) is called with this panel's class name before applying changes to this panel.

See also [PANEL:PostAutoRefresh](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:PostAutoRefresh)

entries.name: Prepare
entries.description:
**INTERNAL**: This is used internally - although you're able to use it you probably shouldn't.

Installs Lua defined functions into the panel.

entries.name: Queue
entries.description: Enables the queue for panel animations. If enabled, the next new animation will begin after all current animations have ended. This must be called before [Panel:NewAnimation](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:NewAnimation) to work, and only applies to the next new animation. If you want to queue many, you must call this before each.

entries.name: RebuildSpawnIcon
entries.description: Causes a [SpawnIcon](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/SpawnIcon) to rebuild its model image.

entries.name: RebuildSpawnIconEx
entries.description:
Re-renders a spawn icon with customized cam data.

[Global.PositionSpawnIcon](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Global.PositionSpawnIcon) can be used to easily calculate the necessary camera parameters.

**NOTE**: This function does **not** accept the standard [Structures/CamData](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Structures/CamData).

args.name: data
args.description:
A table containing the information needed to re-render the icon:
* Vector cam_pos - The relative camera position the model is viewed from.
* Angle cam_ang - The camera angle the model is viewed from.
* number cam_fov - The camera's field of view (FOV).
* Entity ent - The entity object of the model.

Optional keys:
* table lightbox - (As of 2026.08.26) Sets the "lightbox" for the model render. Wants 6 vectors (start index = 1). See render.SetModelLighting.
* table lights - (As of 2026.08.26) Sets the "dynamic lights" for the model render. Same format as render.SetLocalModelLights.

See the example below for how to retrieve these values.

entries.name: Receiver
entries.description: Allows the panel to receive drag and drop events. Can be called multiple times with different names to receive multiple different draggable panel events.

args.name: name
args.description: Name of DnD panels to receive. This is set on the drag'n'drop-able panels via  Panel:Droppable

args.name: func
args.description:
This function is called whenever a panel with valid name is hovering above and dropped on this panel. 



Function argument(s):
* Panel `pnl` - The receiver panel
* table `tbl` - A table of panels dropped onto receiver panel
* boolean `dropped` - False if hovering over, true if dropped onto
* number `menuIndex` - Index of clicked menu item from third argument of Panel:Receiver
* number `x` - Cursor pos, relative to the receiver
* number `y` - Cursor pos, relative to the receiver

arguments.description: Cursor pos, relative to the receiver

args.description: A table of strings that will act as a menu if drag'n'drop was performed with a right click

entries.name: Refresh
entries.description: Refreshes the HTML panel's current page.

args.description: If true, the refresh will ignore cached content similar to "ctrl+f5" in most browsers.

entries.name: Remove
entries.description:
Marks a panel for deletion so it will be deleted on the next frame.

This will not mark child panels for deletion this frame, but they will be marked and deleted in the next frame.

See also [Panel:IsMarkedForDeletion](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:IsMarkedForDeletion)

Will automatically call [Panel:InvalidateParent](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:InvalidateParent).

entries.name: RequestFocus
entries.description: Attempts to obtain focus for this panel.

entries.name: ResetAllFades
entries.description: Resets all text fades in a [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText) element made with [Panel:InsertFade](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:InsertFade).

args.name: hold
args.description: True to reset fades, false otherwise.

args.name: expiredOnly
args.description: Any value equating to `true` will reset fades only on text segments that are completely faded out.

args.name: newSustain
args.description: The new sustain value of each faded text segment. Set to -1 to keep the old sustain value.

entries.name: RunJavascript
entries.description:
Executes a string as JavaScript code on a web document panel.

**NOTE**: This function does **NOT** allow you to pass variables from JavaScript (JS) to Lua context.  
If you wish to pass/return values from JS to Lua, you may want to use [DHTML:AddFunction](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DHTML:AddFunction) function to accomplish that job.


**NOTE**: The Awesomium web renderer automatically delays the code execution if the document is not ready, but the Chromium web renderer does not!

This means that with Chromium, you cannot JavaScript run code immediatly after calling [Panel:SetHTML](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetHTML) or [Panel:OpenURL](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:OpenURL). You should wait for the events [HTML:OnDocumentReady](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/HTML:OnDocumentReady) or [HTML:OnFinishLoadingDocument](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/HTML:OnFinishLoadingDocument) to be triggered before proceeding, otherwise you may manipulate an empty / incomplete document.

args.name: js
args.description: Specify JavaScript code to be executed.

entries.name: SaveUndoState
entries.description:
Saves the current state (caret position and the text inside) of a [TextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/TextEntry) as an undo state.

See also [Panel:Undo](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:Undo).

entries.name: ScreenToLocal
entries.description:
Translates global screen coordinate to coordinates relative to the panel.

See also [Panel:LocalToScreen](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:LocalToScreen).

**WARNING**: This function uses a cached value for the screen position of the panel, computed at the end of the last VGUI Think/Layout pass, so inaccurate results may be returned if the panel or any of its ancestors have been re-positioned outside of [PANEL:Think](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:Think) or [PANEL:PerformLayout](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:PerformLayout) within the last frame.

args.name: screenX
args.description: The x coordinate of the screen position to be translated.

args.name: screenY
args.description: The y coordinate of the screed position be to translated.

returns.description: Relativeposition X
Relativeposition Y

entries.name: SelectAll
entries.description:
Selects all items within a panel or object. For text-based objects, selects all text.

**NOTE**: Only works on [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText) and [TextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/TextEntry) and their derived panels by default (such as [DTextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DTextEntry)), and on any panel that manually reimplemented this method.

args.name: resetCursorPos
args.description: Reset cursor pos?

entries.name: SelectNone

Deselects all items in a panel object. For text-based objects, this will deselect all text.

**NOTE**: Only works on [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText) and [TextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/TextEntry) and their derived panels by default (such as [DTextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DTextEntry)), and on any panel that manually reimplemented this method.

entries.name: SetAchievement
entries.description: Sets the achievement to be displayed by [AchievementIcon](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/AchievementIcon).

args.name: id
args.description: Achievement number ID

entries.name: SetAllowNonAsciiCharacters
entries.description:
Configures a [TextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/TextEntry) to allow user to type characters that are not included in the US-ASCII (7-bit ASCII) character set.

Characters not included in US-ASCII are multi-byte characters in UTF-8. They can be accented characters, non-Latin characters and special characters.

args.name: allowed
args.description: Set to true in order not to restrict input characters.

entries.name: SetAlpha
entries.description: Sets the alpha multiplier for the panel

args.name: alpha

entries.name: SetAnimationEnabled
entries.description: Enables or disables animations for the panel object by overriding the [PANEL:AnimationThink](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:AnimationThink) hook to nil and back.

args.name: enable

entries.name: SetAutoDelete
entries.description: Sets whenever the panel should be removed if the parent was removed.

args.name: autoDelete

entries.name: SetBGColor
entries.description:
Sets the background color of a panel such as a [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText), [Label](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Label), [DColorCube](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DColorCube) or the base [Panel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel).

For many panels, such as [DLabel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DLabel) and [Panel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel), you must use [Panel:SetPaintBackgroundEnabled](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetPaintBackgroundEnabled)( true ) for the background to appear.

Please note that for most panels the engine will overwrite the foreground and background colors a frame after panel creation via the [PANEL:ApplySchemeSettings](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:ApplySchemeSettings) hook, so you may want to set the color in that hook instead.

See [Panel:SetFGColor](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetFGColor) for the foreground color.

**NOTE**: This doesn't apply to all VGUI elements and its function varies between them

args.name: r

args.name: g

args.name: b

args.name: a

entries.description:
**INTERNAL**: This is used internally - although you're able to use it you probably shouldn't.
Sets the background color of the panel.

args.name: r

args.name: g
args.description: The green channel of the color.

args.name: b

entries.name: SetContentAlignment

Sets the alignment of the contents.

**NOTE**: This function only works on [Label](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Label) panels and its derivatives.

**NOTE**: This function doesnt work, if [Panel:SetWrap](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetWrap) is true.

The direction of the content, based on the number pad. See Enums/ContentAlignment.

1: **bottom-left** 
2: **bottom-center**

4: **middle-left** 
5: **center** 
6: **middle-right** 
7: **top-left** 
8: **top-center** 
9: **top-right**

entries.name: SetConVar
entries.description:
**WARNING**: This function does not exist on all panels

**WARNING**: This function cannot interact with serverside convars unless you are host

**NOTE**: Blocked convars will not work with this, see [Blocked ConCommands](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Blocked_ConCommands)


Sets this panel's convar. When the convar changes this panel will update automatically.

For developer implementation, see [Global.Derma_Install_Convar_Functions](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Global.Derma_Install_Convar_Functions).

args.name: convar
args.description: The console variable to check.

entries.name: SetCookie
entries.description:
Stores a string in the named cookie using [Panel:GetCookieName](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetCookieName) as prefix.

You can also retrieve and modify this cookie by using the [cookie](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/cookie). Cookies are stored in this format:

```
panelCookieName.cookieName
```


**WARNING**: The panel's cookie name MUST be set for this function to work. See [Panel:SetCookieName](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetCookieName).

args.name: cookieName
args.description: The unique name used to retrieve the cookie later.

args.name: value
args.description: The value to store in the cookie. This can be retrieved later as a string or number.

entries.name: SetCookieName
entries.description: Sets the panel's cookie name. Calls [PANEL:LoadCookies](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:LoadCookies) if defined.

args.name: name
args.description: The panel's cookie name. Used as prefix for Panel:SetCookie, therefore should be a unique value.

entries.name: SetCursor
entries.description: Sets the appearance of the cursor. You can find a list of all available cursors with image previews [here](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors).

args.name: cursor
args.description:
The cursor to be set. Can be one of the following:

* [arrow](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=arrow)
* [beam](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=beam)
* [hourglass](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=hourglass)
* [waitarrow](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=waitarrow)
* [crosshair](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=crosshair)
* [up](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=up)
* [sizenwse](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=sizenwse)
* [sizenesw](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=sizenesw)
* [sizewe](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=sizewe)
* [sizens](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=sizens)
* [sizeall](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=sizeall)
* [no](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=no)
* [hand](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=hand)
* [blank](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=blank)

Set to anything else to set it to "none", the default fallback. Do note that a value of "none" does not, as one might assume, result in no cursor being drawn - hiding the cursor requires a value of "blank" instead.

entries.name: SetDragParent
entries.description:
Sets the drag parent.

Drag parent means that when we start to drag this panel, we'll really start dragging the defined parent.

args.name: parent
args.description: The panel to set as drag parent.

entries.name: SetDrawLanguageID
entries.description:
Sets the visibility of the language selection box when typing in non-English mode.

		See [Panel:SetDrawLanguageIDAtLeft](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetDrawLanguageIDAtLeft) for a function that changes the position of the language selection box.

args.name: visible
args.description: true to make it visible, false to hide it.

entries.name: SetDrawLanguageIDAtLeft
entries.description:
Sets where to draw the language selection box.

See [Panel:SetDrawLanguageID](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetDrawLanguageID) for a function that hides or shows the language selection box.

args.name: left
args.description: true = left, false = right

entries.name: SetDrawOnTop
entries.description:
Makes the panel render in front of all others, including the spawn menu and main menu.

Priority is given based on the last call, so of two panels that call this method, the second will draw in front of the first.

**NOTE**: This only makes the panel **draw** above other panels. If there's another panel that would have otherwise covered it, users will not be able to interact with it.

Completely disregards [PANEL:ParentToHUD](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:ParentToHUD).


**WARNING**: This does not work when using [PANEL:SetPaintedManually](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:SetPaintedManually) or [PANEL:PaintAt](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:PaintAt).

args.name: drawOnTop
args.description: Whether or not to draw the panel in front of all others.

entries.name: SetDropTarget
entries.description:
Sets the target area for dropping when an object is being dragged around this panel using the [dragndrop](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/dragndrop). 

This draws a target box of the specified size and position, until [Panel:DragHoverEnd](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:DragHoverEnd) is called. It uses [Panel:DrawDragHover](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:DrawDragHover) to draw this area.

args.name: x
args.description: The x coordinate of the top-left corner of the drop area.

args.name: y
args.description: The y coordinate of the top-left corner of the drop area.

args.name: width
args.description: The width of the drop area.

args.name: height
args.description: The height of the drop area.

entries.name: SetEnabled
entries.description:
Sets the enabled state of a panel object that supports being disabled, such as a [DButton](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DButton) or [DTextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DTextEntry).

Disabled panels cannot be interacted with, and have a different appearance to indicate this.

See [Panel:IsEnabled](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:IsEnabled) for a function that retrieves the "enabled" state of a panel.

args.name: enable
args.description: Whether to enable or disable the panel object.

entries.name: SetExpensiveShadow
entries.description:
Adds a shadow falling to the bottom right corner of the panel's text.

**NOTE**: This works only on  panels that derive from [Label](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Label).

args.name: distance
args.description: The distance of the shadow from the panel.

args.name: Color
args.description: The color of the shadow. Uses Color.

entries.name: SetFGColor
entries.description:
Sets the foreground color of a panel.

For a [Label](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Label) or [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText), this is the color of its text.

This function calls [Panel:SetFGColorEx](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetFGColorEx) internally. 

Please note that for most panels the engine will overwrite the foreground and background colors a frame after panel creation via the [PANEL:ApplySchemeSettings](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:ApplySchemeSettings) hook, so you may want to set the color in that hook instead.

See [Panel:SetBGColor](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetBGColor) for the background color.

**NOTE**: This doesn't apply to all VGUI elements (such as [DLabel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DLabel)) and its function varies between them

args.name: r
args.description: The red channel of the color.

args.name: g
args.description: The green channel of the color.

args.name: b
args.description: The blue channel of the color.

args.name: a
args.description: The alpha channel of the color.

args.name: color
args.description: A Color object/table to read the color from. This is slower than providing four numbers. You could use Color:Unpack to address this. You should also cache your color objects if you wish to use them, for performance reasons.

entries.name: SetFGColorEx
entries.description:
**INTERNAL**: This is used internally - although you're able to use it you probably shouldn't.
Sets the foreground color of the panel.

For labels, this is the color of their text.

args.name: r
args.description: The red channel of the color.

args.name: g
args.description: The green channel of the color.

args.name: b
args.description: The blue channel of the color.

args.name: a
args.description: The alpha channel of the color.

entries.name: SetFocusTopLevel
entries.description:
Sets the panel that owns this FocusNavGroup to be the root in the focus traversal hierarchy. This function will only work on EditablePanel class panels and its derivatives.
    
    **NOTE**: Child panels that should be part of the tab navigation need [Panel:SetTabPosition](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetTabPosition) called on them.

entries.name: SetFontInternal
entries.description:
Sets the font used to render this panel's text. This works for [Label](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Label), [TextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/TextEntry) and [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText), but it's a better idea to use their local `SetFont` ([DTextEntry:SetFont](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DTextEntry:SetFont), [DLabel:SetFont](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DLabel:SetFont)) methods when available.

To retrieve the font used by a panel, call [Panel:GetFont](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetFont).

args.name: fontName
args.description:
The name of the font.

See Default_Fonts for a list of existing fonts.
Alternatively, use surface.CreateFont to create your own custom font.

entries.name: SetHeight
entries.description:
Sets the height of the panel.

Calls [PANEL:OnSizeChanged](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:OnSizeChanged) and marks this panel for layout ([Panel:InvalidateLayout](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:InvalidateLayout)).
Automatically rounds the height down

See also [Panel:SetSize](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetSize).

args.name: height
args.description: The height to be set.

entries.name: SetHTML
entries.description: Allows you to set HTML code within a panel.

args.name: HTML
args.description: The HTML code to set.

entries.name: SetKeyBoardInputEnabled
entries.description: Enables or disables the keyboard input for the panel.

args.name: keyboardInput
args.description: Whether to enable or disable keyboard input.

entries.deprecated: Alias of Panel:SetKeyboardInputEnabled(lowercase)

entries.name: SetKeyboardInputEnabled
entries.description: Allows or disallows the panel to receive keyboard focus and input. This is recursively applied to all children.

args.name: enable
args.description: Whether keyboard input should be enabled for this panel.

entries.name: SetLineHeight
entries.description: Sets the height of a single line of a [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText) panel.

args.name: height
args.description: The new line height. Values below zero mean no override.

entries.name: SetMaximumCharCount
entries.description:
Sets the maximum character count this panel should have.

This function will only work on [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText) and [TextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/TextEntry) panels and their derivatives.

args.name: maxChar
args.description: The new maximum amount of characters this panel is allowed to contain.

entries.name: SetMinimumSize
entries.description:
Sets the minimum dimensions of the panel or object.

You can restrict either or both values.

Calling the function without arguments will remove the minimum size.

args.name: minW
args.description: The minimum width of the object.

args.name: minH
args.description: The minimum height of the object.

entries.name: SetModel
entries.description:
Sets the model to be displayed by [SpawnIcon](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/SpawnIcon).

**NOTE**: This must be called after setting size if you wish to use a different size spawnicon

args.name: ModelPath
args.description: The path of the model to set

args.name: skin
args.description: The skin to set

args.name: bodygroups
args.description: The body groups to set. Each single-digit number in the string represents a separate bodygroup, **This argument must be 9 characters in total**.

entries.name: SetMouseInputEnabled
entries.description:
Enables or disables the mouse input for the panel.
		**NOTE**: Panels parented to the context menu will not be clickable unless [Panel:SetKeyboardInputEnabled](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetKeyboardInputEnabled(lowercase)) is enabled or [Panel:MakePopup](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:MakePopup) has been called. If you want the panel to have mouse input but you do not want to prevent players from moving, set [Panel:SetKeyboardInputEnabled](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetKeyboardInputEnabled(lowercase)) to false immediately after calling [Panel:MakePopup](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:MakePopup).

args.name: mouseInput
args.description: Whenever to enable or disable mouse input.

entries.name: SetMultiline
entries.description: Enables or disables the multi-line functionality of [TextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/TextEntry) panel and its derivatives.

args.name: multiline
args.description: Whether to enable multiline or not.

entries.name: SetName
entries.description: Sets the internal name of the panel. Can be retrieved with [Panel:GetName](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetName).

args.name: name
args.description: The new name of the panel.

entries.name: SetOpenLinksExternally
entries.description: Set to true to open links in an external browser. This only functions on the `x86-64` beta.

entries.name: SetPaintBackgroundEnabled
entries.description: Sets whether the default background of the panel should be drawn or not. It's color is usually set by [Panel:SetBGColor](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetBGColor).

args.name: paintBackground
args.description: Whether to draw the background or not.

entries.name: SetPaintBorderEnabled
entries.description: Sets whether the default border of the panel should be drawn or not.

args.name: paintBorder
args.description: Whether to draw the border or not.

entries.name: SetPaintedManually
entries.description: Enables or disables painting of the panel manually with [Panel:PaintManual](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:PaintManual).

args.name: paintedManually
args.description: True if the panel should be painted manually.

entries.name: SetParent
entries.description:
Sets the parent of the panel.
	**NOTE**: Panels parented to the context menu will not be clickable unless [Panel:SetMouseInputEnabled](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetMouseInputEnabled) and [Panel:SetKeyboardInputEnabled](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetKeyboardInputEnabled(lowercase)) are both true or [Panel:MakePopup](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:MakePopup) has been called. If you want the panel to have mouse input but you do not want to prevent players from moving, set [Panel:SetKeyboardInputEnabled](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetKeyboardInputEnabled(lowercase)) to false immediately after calling [Panel:MakePopup](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:MakePopup).

args.name: parent
args.description: The new parent of the panel.

entries.name: SetPlayer
entries.description: Used by [AvatarImage](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/AvatarImage) to load an avatar for given player.

args.name: player
args.description: The player to use avatar of.

args.name: size
args.description: The size of the avatar to use. Acceptable sizes are `32`, `64`, `184`. Non matching sizes will be clamped down to the highest valid number.

entries.name: SetPopupStayAtBack
entries.description: If this panel object has been made a popup with [Panel:MakePopup](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:MakePopup), this method will prevent it from drawing in front of other panels when it receives input focus.

args.name: stayAtBack
args.description: If `true`, the popup panel will not draw in front of others when it gets focus, for example when it is clicked.

entries.name: SetPos
entries.description:
Sets the position of the panel's top left corner.

This will trigger [PANEL:PerformLayout](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:PerformLayout). You should avoid calling this function in [PANEL:PerformLayout](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:PerformLayout) to avoid infinite loops.

See also [Panel:SetX](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetX) and [Panel:SetY](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetY).

**NOTE**: If you wish to position and re-size panels without much guesswork and have them look good on different screen resolutions, you may find [Panel:Dock](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:Dock) useful

args.name: posX
args.description: The x coordinate of the position.

args.name: posY
args.description: The y coordinate of the position.

entries.name: SetRenderInScreenshots
entries.description: Sets whenever the panel should be rendered in a screenshot. (`jpeg` or `screenshot` commands, Camera SWEP)

args.name: renderInScreenshot
args.description: Whether to render in the screenshot or not.

entries.name: SetSelectable
entries.description: Sets whether the panel object can be selected or not (like icons in the Spawn Menu, holding Shift). If enabled, this will affect the function of a [DButton](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DButton) whilst Shift is pressed. [Panel:SetSelected](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetSelected) can be used to select/deselect the object.

args.name: selectable
args.description: Whether the panel object should be selectable or not.

entries.name: SetSelected
entries.description: Sets the selected state of a selectable panel object. This functionality is set with [Panel:SetSelectable](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetSelectable) and checked with [Panel:IsSelectable](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:IsSelectable).

args.name: selected
args.description: Whether the object should be selected or deselected. Panel:IsSelected can be used to determine the selected state of the object.

entries.name: SetSelectionCanvas
entries.description: Enables the panel object for selection (much like the spawn menu).

args.name: set
args.description: Whether to enable selection.

entries.name: SetSize
entries.description:
Sets the size of the panel.

Calls [PANEL:OnSizeChanged](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:OnSizeChanged) and marks this panel for layout ([Panel:InvalidateLayout](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:InvalidateLayout)).
Automatically rounds the width and height down


See also [Panel:SetWidth](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetWidth) and [Panel:SetHeight](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetHeight).

**NOTE**: If you wish to position and re-size panels without much guesswork and have them look good on different screen resolutions, you may find [Panel:Dock](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:Dock) useful

args.name: width
args.description: The width of the panel.

args.name: height
args.description: The height of the panel.

entries.name: SetSkin
entries.description: Sets the derma skin that the panel object will use, and refreshes all panels with [derma.RefreshSkins](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/derma.RefreshSkins).

args.name: skinName
args.description: The name of the skin to use. The default derma skin is `Default`.

entries.name: SetSpawnIcon
entries.description:
Sets the `.png` image to be displayed on a  [SpawnIcon](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/SpawnIcon) or the panel it is based on - [ModelImage](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/ModelImage).

Only `.png` images can be used with this function.

args.name: icon
args.description: A path to the .png material, for example one of the Silkicons shipped with the game.

entries.name: SetSteamID
entries.description: Used by [AvatarImage](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/AvatarImage) panels to load an avatar by its 64-bit Steam ID (community ID).

args.name: steamid
args.description: The 64bit SteamID of the player to load avatar of

args.name: size
args.description: The size of the avatar to use. Acceptable sizes are 32, 64, 184.

entries.name: SetTabPosition
entries.description:
When TAB is pressed, the next selectable panel in the number sequence is selected.

		**NOTE**: This function requires [Panel:SetFocusTopLevel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetFocusTopLevel) to be called on the parent panel for tab navigation to work.

entries.name: SetTall
entries.description: Sets height of a panel. An alias of [Panel:SetHeight](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetHeight).

args.name: height
args.description: Desired height to set

entries.name: SetTerm
entries.description:
Removes the panel after given time in seconds.
**NOTE**: This function will not work if [PANEL:AnimationThink](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:AnimationThink) is overridden, unless [Panel:AnimationThinkInternal](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:AnimationThinkInternal) is called every frame.

args.name: delay
args.description: Delay in seconds after which the panel should be removed.

entries.name: SetText
entries.description:
Sets the text value of a panel object containing text, such as a [Label](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Label), [TextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/TextEntry) or  [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText) and their derivatives, such as [DLabel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DLabel), [DTextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DTextEntry) or [DButton](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DButton).

**WARNING**: When used on a [Label](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Label) or its derivatives ( [DLabel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DLabel) and [DButton](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DButton) ), it will automatically call [Panel:InvalidateLayout](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:InvalidateLayout), meaning that you should avoid running this function every frame on these panels to avoid unnecessary performance loss.


**WARNING**: [Label](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Label) & its derivatives has hard length limit, maximum 1023 ascii characters.

args.name: text
args.description: The text value to set.

entries.name: SetTextHidden
entries.description: Makes [TextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/TextEntry)'s text be replaced by `*` characters, just like a password-entry text field would.

args.description: Whether to have the text be hidden.

entries.name: SetTextInset
entries.description: Sets the left and top text margins of a text-based panel object, such as a [DButton](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DButton) or [DLabel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DLabel).

args.name: insetX
args.description: The left margin for the text, in pixels. This will only affect centered text if the margin is greater than its x-coordinate.

args.name: insetY
args.description: The top margin for the text, in pixels.

entries.name: SetTextSelectionColors
entries.description: Sets text selection colors of a [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText) element.

args.name: textColor
args.description: The Color to set for selected text.

args.name: backgroundColor
args.description: The Color to set for selected text background.

entries.name: SetToFullHeight
entries.description:
Sets the height of a [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText) element to accommodate the text inside.

**NOTE**: This function internally relies on [Panel:GetNumLines](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetNumLines), so it should be called at least a couple frames after modifying the text using [Panel:AppendText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:AppendText)

entries.name: SetTooltip
entries.description:
Sets the tooltip to be displayed when a player hovers over the panel object with their cursor.

By default, [DTooltip](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DTooltip) will be used. [Panel:SetTooltipPanelOverride](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetTooltipPanelOverride) can be used to override the tooltip panel.

args.name: str
args.description: The text to be displayed in the tooltip. Set `nil` to disable it.

entries.name: SetTooltipDelay
entries.description:
Sets the tooltip delay. (time between hovering over the panel, and the tooltip showing up)

Can be retrieved with [Panel:GetTooltipDelay](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetTooltipDelay).

args.name: tooltip
args.description: The tooltip delay to set.

entries.name: SetTooltipPanel
entries.description:
Sets the panel to be displayed as contents of a [DTooltip](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DTooltip) when a player hovers over the panel object with their cursor. See [Panel:SetTooltipPanelOverride](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetTooltipPanelOverride) if you are looking to override [DTooltip](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DTooltip) itself.

**NOTE**: [Panel:SetTooltip](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetTooltip) will override this functionality.


**WARNING**: Calling this from [PANEL:OnCursorEntered](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:OnCursorEntered) is too late! The tooltip will not be displayed or be updated.

	Given panel or the previously set one will **NOT** be automatically removed.

args.name: tooltipPanel
args.description: The panel to use as the tooltip.

entries.name: SetTooltipPanelOverride
entries.description: Sets the panel class to be created instead of [DTooltip](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DTooltip) when the player hovers over this panel and a tooltip needs creating.

args.name: override
args.description:
The panel class to override the default DTooltip. The new panel class must have the following methods:
* Panel:SetText - If you are using Panel:SetTooltip.
* DTooltip:SetContents - If you are using Panel:SetTooltipPanel.
* DTooltip:OpenForPanel - A "hook" type function that gets called shortly after creation (and after the above 2) to open and position the tooltip. You can see this logic in `lua/includes/util/tooltips.lua`.

entries.name: SetUnderlineFont
entries.description:
Sets the underlined font for use by clickable text in a [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText). See also [Panel:InsertClickableTextStart](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:InsertClickableTextStart)

This function will only work on [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText) panels.

args.name: fontName
args.description:
The name of the font.

See Default_Fonts for a list of existing fonts.
Alternatively, use surface.CreateFont to create your own custom font.

entries.name: SetURL
entries.description: Sets the URL of a link-based panel such as [DLabelURL](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DLabelURL).

args.name: url
args.description: The URL to set. It **must** begin with either `http://` or `https://`.

entries.name: SetVerticalScrollbarEnabled
entries.description:
Sets the visibility of the vertical scrollbar.

Works for [RichText](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/RichText) and [TextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/TextEntry).

args.name: display
args.description: True to display the vertical text scroll bar, false to hide it.

entries.name: SetVisible
entries.description: Sets the "visibility" of the panel.

args.name: visible
args.description: The visibility of the panel.

entries.name: SetWide
entries.description: Sets width of a panel. An alias of [Panel:SetWidth](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetWidth).

args.name: width
args.description: Desired width to set

entries.name: SetWidth
entries.description:
Sets the width of the panel.

Calls [PANEL:OnSizeChanged](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PANEL:OnSizeChanged) and marks this panel for layout ([Panel:InvalidateLayout](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:InvalidateLayout)).
Automatically rounds the width down

See also [Panel:SetSize](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetSize).

args.name: width
args.description: The new width of the panel.

entries.name: SetWorldClicker
entries.description: This makes it so that when you're hovering over this panel you can "click" on the world. Your weapon aim (and its viewmodel) will follow the cursor. This is primarily used for the Sandbox context menu.

args.name: enable
args.description: Whether to enable or disable the feature for this panel.

entries.name: SetWrap
entries.description:
Sets whether text wrapping should be enabled or disabled on [Label](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Label) and [DLabel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DLabel) panels.

Use [DLabel:SetAutoStretchVertical](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DLabel:SetAutoStretchVertical) to automatically correct vertical size; [Panel:SizeToContents](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SizeToContents) will not set the correct height.

args.name: wrap
args.description: `True` to enable text wrapping, `false` otherwise.

entries.name: SetX
entries.description:
Sets the X position of the panel.

Uses [Panel:SetPos](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetPos) internally.

args.name: x
args.description: The X coordinate of the position.

entries.name: SetY
entries.description:
Sets the Y position of the panel.

Uses [Panel:SetPos](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetPos) internally.

args.name: y
args.description: The Y coordinate of the position.

entries.name: SetZPos
entries.description:
Sets the panels z position which determines the rendering order.

Panels with lower z positions appear behind panels with higher z positions.

This also controls in which order panels docked with [Panel:Dock](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:Dock) appears.

args.name: zIndex
args.description:
The z position of the panel. 
Can't be lower than -32768 or higher than 32767.

entries.name: Show
entries.description: Makes a panel visible.

entries.name: SizeTo
entries.description: Uses animation to resize the panel to the specified size.

args.name: sizeW
args.description: The target width of the panel. Use -1 to retain the current width.

args.name: sizeH
args.description: The target height of the panel. Use -1 to retain the current height.

args.name: time
args.description: The time to perform the animation within.

args.name: delay
args.description: The delay before the animation starts.

args.name: ease
args.description: Easing of the start and/or end speed of the animation. See Panel:NewAnimation for how this works.

args.name: callback
args.description:
The function to be called once the animation finishes.


Function argument(s):
* table `animData` - The Structures/AnimationData that was used.
* Panel `targetPanel` - The panel object that was animated.

arguments.name: targetPanel
arguments.description: The panel object that was animated.

entries.name: SizeToChildren
entries.description:
Resizes the panel to fit the bounds of its children.

**NOTE**: Your panel must have its layout updated ([Panel:InvalidateLayout](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:InvalidateLayout)) for this function to work properly.

**NOTE**: The sizeW and sizeH parameters are false by default. Therefore, calling this function with no arguments will result in a no-op.

args.name: sizeW
args.description: Resize with width of the panel.

args.name: sizeH
args.description: Resize the height of the panel.

entries.name: SizeToContents
entries.description:
Resizes the panel so that its width and height fit all of the content inside.

**NOTE**: Only works on [Label](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Label) derived panels such as [DLabel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DLabel) by default, and on any panel that manually implemented the [Panel:SizeToContents](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SizeToContents) method, such as [DNumberWang](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DNumberWang) and [DImage](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DImage).


**WARNING**: You must call this function **AFTER** setting text/font, adjusting child panels or otherwise altering the panel.

entries.name: SizeToContentsX
entries.description:
Resizes the panel object's width to accommodate all child objects/contents.

Only works on [Label](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Label) derived panels such as [DLabel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DLabel) by default, and on any panel that manually implemented [Panel:GetContentSize](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetContentSize) method.

**NOTE**: You must call this function **AFTER** setting text/font or adjusting child panels.

args.name: addVal
args.description: The number of extra pixels to add to the width. Can be a negative number, to reduce the width.

entries.name: SizeToContentsY
entries.description:
Resizes the panel object's height to accommodate all child objects/contents.

Only works on [Label](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Label) derived panels such as [DLabel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/DLabel) by default, and on any panel that manually implemented [Panel:GetContentSize](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetContentSize) method.

**NOTE**: You must call this function **AFTER** setting text/font or adjusting child panels.

args.name: addVal
args.description: The number of extra pixels to add to the height.

entries.name: SlideDown
entries.description: Slides the panel in from above.

args.name: Length
args.description: Time to complete the animation.

entries.name: SlideUp
entries.description: Slides the panel out to the top.

args.name: Length
args.description: Time to complete the animation.

entries.name: StartBoxSelection
entries.description: Begins a box selection, enables mouse capture for the panel object, and sets the start point of the selection box to the mouse cursor's position, relative to this object. For this to work, either the object or its parent must be enabled as a selection canvas. This is set using [Panel:SetSelectionCanvas](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetSelectionCanvas).

entries.name: Stop
entries.description: Stops all panel animations by clearing its animation list. This also clears all delayed animations.

entries.name: StopLoading
entries.description: Stops the loading of the [HTML](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/HTML) panel's current page.

entries.name: StretchBottomTo
entries.description: Resizes the panel object's height so that its bottom is aligned with the top of the passed panel. An offset greater than zero will reduce the panel's height to leave a gap between it and the passed panel.

args.name: tgtPanel
args.description: The panel to align the bottom of this one with.

args.name: offset
args.description: The gap to leave between this and the passed panel. Negative values will cause the panel's height to increase, forming an overlap.

entries.name: StretchRightTo
entries.description: Resizes the panel object's width so that its right edge is aligned with the left of the passed panel. An offset greater than zero will reduce the panel's width to leave a gap between it and the passed panel.

args.name: tgtPanel
args.description: The panel to align the right edge of this one with.

args.name: offset
args.description: The gap to leave between this and the passed panel. Negative values will cause the panel's width to increase, forming an overlap.

entries.name: StretchToParent
entries.description: Sets the dimensions of the panel to fill its parent. It will only stretch in directions that aren't nil.

args.name: offsetLeft
args.description: The left offset to the parent.

args.name: offsetTop
args.description: The top offset to the parent.

args.name: offsetRight
args.description: The right offset to the parent.

args.name: offsetBottom
args.description: The bottom offset to the parent.

entries.name: TestHover
entries.description: Called to test if the panel is being `hovered` by the mouse. This will only be called if the panel's parent is being hovered.

args.name: x
args.description: The x coordinate of the cursor, in screen space.

args.name: y
args.description: The y coordinate of the cursor, in screen space.

returns.description: Return false when the cursor is not considered on the panel, true if it is considered on the panel. Do not return anything for default behavior.

entries.name: Think
entries.description: Called every frame while [Panel:IsVisible](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:IsVisible) is true.

entries.name: ToggleSelection
entries.description: Toggles the selected state of a selectable panel object. This functionality is set with [Panel:SetSelectable](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetSelectable) and checked with [Panel:IsSelectable](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:IsSelectable). To check whether the object is selected or not, [Panel:IsSelected](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:IsSelected) is used.

entries.name: ToggleVisible
entries.description: Toggles the visibility of a panel and all its children.

entries.name: Undo
entries.description:
Restores the last saved state (caret position and the text inside) of a [TextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/TextEntry). Should act identically to pressing CTRL+Z in a [TextEntry](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/TextEntry).

See also [Panel:SaveUndoState](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SaveUndoState).

entries.name: UnselectAll
entries.description: Recursively deselects this panel object and all of its children. This will cascade to all child objects at every level below the parent.

entries.name: UpdateHTMLTexture
entries.description:
Forcibly updates the panels' HTML Material, similar to when Paint is called on it.This is only useful if the panel is not normally visible, i.e the panel exists purely for its HTML Material.
**NOTE**: Only works on with panels that have a HTML Material. See [Panel:GetHTMLMaterial](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:GetHTMLMaterial) for more details.

**NOTE**: A good place to call this is in the [GM:PreRender](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:PreRender) hook

entries.name: Valid
entries.description: Returns if a given panel is valid or not.

returns.description: Whether the panel is valid or not, true being it is, false being it isn't.

entries.deprecated: Use Panel:IsValid instead.

entries.name: PanelList
entries.description: A panel list with a custom vertical scroll bar that doesn't have up/down buttons and has a momentum to scrolling.
entries.deprecated: You should use DScrollPanel instead

entries.name: PanelPaintState
entries.description: This table is returned by [surface.GetPanelPaintState](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/surface.GetPanelPaintState).

fields.name: translate_x
fields.description: The X coordinate for the top-left corner of the Panel currently being drawn.

fields.name: translate_y
fields.description: The Y coordinate for the top-left corner of the Panel currently being drawn.

fields.name: scissor_left
fields.description: The X coordinate for the left edge of the render.SetScissorRect that surrounds the Panel that is currently being drawn.

fields.name: scissor_top
fields.description: The Y coordinate for the top edge of the render.SetScissorRect that surrounds the Panel that is currently being drawn.

fields.name: scissor_right
fields.description: The X coordinate for the right edge of the render.SetScissorRect that surrounds the Panel that is currently being drawn.

fields.name: scissor_bottom
fields.description: The Y coordinate for the bottom edge of the render.SetScissorRect that surrounds the Panel that is currently being drawn.

fields.name: scissor_enabled
fields.description: Whether or not the Panel currently being drawn has render.SetScissorRect active.

entries.name: PathFollower
entries.description: Path object for a NextBot NPC and bots created by [player.CreateNextbot](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/player.CreateNextbot). Returned by [Global.Path](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Global.Path).

entries.name: Chase
entries.description:
Computes the shortest path to the provided entity arg. PathFollower Object must have `Chase` type. 

For PathFollower objects of the `Follow` type use [PathFollower:Compute](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PathFollower:Compute)

args.name: bot
args.description: The bot to update along the path. This can also be a nextbot player (player.CreateNextbot)

args.name: ent
args.description: The entity we want to chase

args.name: generator
args.description:
A function that allows you to alter the path generation. See example on PathFollower:Compute for the default function.



Function argument(s):
* CNavArea `area` - The area to move to.
* CNavArea `fromArea` - The area to move from.
* CNavLadder `ladder` - The ladder to move to or from (Validation required), if any.
* Entity `elevator` - Will probably be always NULL
* number `length` - Precomputed length between `area` and `fromArea`.

Function return value(s):
* number `cost` - The cost of movement between `area` and `fromArea`.

arguments.name: ladder
arguments.description: The ladder to move to or from (Validation required), if any.

returns.name: cost
returns.description: The cost of movement between `area` and `fromArea`.

entries.name: Compute
entries.description:
Compute shortest path from bot to 'goal' via A* algorithm. This only works if the PathFollower is the `Follow` Type. 

For PathFollowers of the `Chase` Type see [PathFollower:Chase](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PathFollower:Chase)

args.name: bot
args.description: The nextbot we're generating for.  This can also be a nextbot player (player.CreateNextbot).

args.name: goal
args.description: The target location, the goal.

args.name: generator
args.description:
A function that allows you to alter the path generation by adjusting the "cost". See example below for the default function.



Function argument(s):
* CNavArea `area` - The area to move to.
* CNavArea `fromArea` - The area to move from.
* CNavLadder `ladder` - The ladder to move to or from (Validation required), if any.
* Entity `elevator` - Will probably be always NULL
* number `length` - Precomputed length between `area` and `fromArea`.

Function return value(s):
* number `cost` - The cost of movement between `area` and `fromArea`.

arguments.name: ladder
arguments.description: The ladder to move to or from (Validation required), if any.

returns.name: cost
returns.description: The cost of movement between `area` and `fromArea`.

* If returns true, path was found to the goal position.
* If returns false, path may either be invalid (use IsValid() to check), or valid but doesn't reach all the way to the goal.

entries.name: Draw
entries.description: Draws the path. This is meant for debugging - and uses [debugoverlay](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/debugoverlay).

entries.name: FirstSegment
entries.description: Returns the first segment of the path.

returns.description: A table with Structures/PathSegment.

entries.name: GetAge
entries.description: Returns the age since the path was built

returns.description: Path age

entries.name: GetAllSegments
entries.description: Returns all of the segments of the given path.

returns.description: A table of tables with Structures/PathSegment.

entries.name: GetClosestPosition
entries.description: The closest position along the path to a position

args.name: position
args.description: The point we're querying for

returns.description: The closest position on the path

entries.name: GetCurrentGoal
entries.description: Returns the current goal data. Can return nil if the current goal is invalid, for example immediately after [PathFollower:Update](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PathFollower:Update).

returns.description: A table with Structures/PathSegment.

entries.name: GetCursorData
entries.description: Returns the cursor data

returns.description:
A table with 3 keys:
number curvature


Vector forward


Vector pos

entries.name: GetCursorPosition
entries.description: Returns the current progress along the path

returns.description: The current progress

entries.name: GetEnd

returns.description: The end position

entries.name: GetGoalTolerance
entries.description: Returns how close we can get to the goal to call it done.

entries.name: GetHindrance

entries.name: GetLength

returns.description: The length of the path

entries.name: GetMinLookAheadDistance
entries.description: Returns the minimum range movement goal must be along path.

args.name: distance
args.description: The distance along the path to query

entries.name: GetStart
entries.description: Returns the path start position

returns.description: The start position

entries.name: Invalidate
entries.description: Invalidates the current path

entries.name: IsValid
entries.description: Returns true if the path is valid

returns.description: Wether the path is valid or not.

entries.name: LastSegment
entries.description: Returns the last segment of the path.

returns.description: A table with Structures/PathSegment.

entries.name: MoveCursor
entries.description:
Moves the cursor by give distance.

For a function that sets the distance, see [PathFollower:MoveCursorTo](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PathFollower:MoveCursorTo).

args.name: distance

entries.name: MoveCursorTo
entries.description:
Sets the cursor position to given distance.

For relative distance, see [PathFollower:MoveCursor](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PathFollower:MoveCursor).

args.name: distance

entries.description: Moves the cursor of the path to the closest position compared to given vector.

Seek type


0 = SEEK_ENTIRE_PATH - Search the entire path length


1 = SEEK_AHEAD - Search from current cursor position forward toward end of path

entries.name: ResetAge

entries.name: SetGoalTolerance

args.name: distance
args.description: The distance we're setting it to

entries.name: SetMinLookAheadDistance
entries.description: Sets minimum range movement goal must be along path

args.name: mindist
args.description: The minimum look ahead distance

entries.name: Update
entries.description:
Move the bot along the path.
    **NOTE**: player nextbots require [CUserCmd:SetForwardMove](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/CUserCmd:SetForwardMove) to move forward along the path

args.name: bot
args.description: The bot to update along the path. This can also be a nextbot player (player.CreateNextbot)

entries.name: PathSegment
entries.description: Structure represents a path segment, returned by [PathFollower:GetCurrentGoal](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PathFollower:GetCurrentGoal), [PathFollower:FirstSegment](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PathFollower:FirstSegment) and [PathFollower:LastSegment](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PathFollower:LastSegment).

fields.name: area
fields.description: The navmesh area this segment occupies.

fields.name: curvature
fields.description: How much of a curve should the bot execute when navigating this segment. 0 = none, 1 = 180°

fields.name: distanceFromStart
fields.description: Distance of this segment from the start of the path.

fields.name: forward
fields.description: The direction of travel to reach the end of this segment from the start, represented as a normalised vector.

fields.name: how
fields.description: The direction of travel to reach the end of this segment from the start, represented as a cardinal direction integer 0 to 3, or 9 for vertical movement.

fields.name: ladder
fields.description: The navmesh ladder this segment occupies, if any.

fields.name: length
fields.description: Length of this segment.

fields.name: pos
fields.description: The position of the end of this segment.

fields.name: type
fields.description:
The movement type of this segment, indicating how bots are expected to move along this segment.
* 0 is ground movement
* 1 is falling down
* 2 is climbing up or jumping
* 3 is jumping over a gap
* 4 is climbing a ladder up (unused)
* 5 is climbing a ladder down (unused)

entries.name: PATTACH
entries.description: Enumerations used by [Global.ParticleEffectAttach](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Global.ParticleEffectAttach).

items.description: Particle spawns in entity's origin and does not follow it
Particle attaches to entity's origin and follows the entity
Create at a custom origin, but don't follow

entries.name: permissions
entries.description: Used to ask player for various potentially dangerous permissions.

entries.name: AskToConnect
entries.description: Requests the player to connect to a specified server. The player will be prompted with a confirmation window.

args.name: address
args.description: The address to ask to connect to. If a port is not given, the default `:27015` port will be added.

entries.name: Connect
entries.description: Connects player to the server. This is what [permissions.AskToConnect](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/permissions.AskToConnect) uses internally.

args.name: ip
args.description: IP address to connect.

entries.name: EnableVoiceChat
entries.description:
Activates player's microphone as if they pressed the speak button themself. The player will be prompted with a confirmation window which grants permission temporarily/permanently(depending on checkbox state) for the connected server (revokable). 
This is used for TTT's traitor voice channel.

args.name: enable
args.description: Enable or disable voice activity. `true` will run `+voicerecord` command, anything else `-voicerecord`.

entries.name: GetAll
entries.description: Returns all permissions per server. Permanent permissions are stored in `settings/permissions.bin`.

returns.name: permissions

entries.name: Grant
entries.description: Grants permission to the current connected server.

args.name: permission
args.description: Permission to grant for the server the player is currently connected.

args.name: temporary
args.description: `true` if the permission should be granted temporary.

entries.name: IsGranted
entries.description: Returns whether the player has granted the current server a specific permission.

args.name: permission
args.description:
The permission to poll. Currently only 2 permission are valid:
* `"connect"`
* `"voicerecord"`

returns.description: Whether the permission is granted or not.

entries.name: Revoke
entries.description: Revokes permission from the server.

args.name: permission
args.description: Permission to revoke from the server.

args.name: ip
args.description: IP of the server.

entries.name: PhysCollide
entries.description:
A PhysCollide holds collision data from VPhysics. These objects can be used to run (currently quite limited) collision tests, but do not represent actual physics objects.

Created by [Global.CreatePhysCollideBox](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Global.CreatePhysCollideBox) or [Global.CreatePhysCollidesFromModel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Global.CreatePhysCollidesFromModel).

entries.name: Destroy
entries.description: Destroys the [PhysCollide](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PhysCollide) object.

entries.name: IsValid
entries.description:
Checks whether this [PhysCollide](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PhysCollide) object is valid or not.

You should just use [Global.IsValid](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Global.IsValid) instead.

returns.description: Is valid or not.

entries.name: TraceBox
entries.description: Performs a trace against this PhysCollide with the given parameters. This can be used for both line traces and box traces.

args.name: origin
args.description: The origin for the PhysCollide during the trace

args.name: angles
args.description: The angles for the PhysCollide during the trace

args.name: rayStart
args.description: The start position of the trace

args.name: rayEnd
args.description: The end position of the trace

args.name: rayMins
args.description: The mins of the trace's bounds

args.name: rayMaxs
args.description: The maxs of the trace's bounds

returns.description: Hit position of the trace. This is false if the trace did not hit.
Hit normal of the trace
Fraction of the trace. This is calculated from the distance between startPos, hitPos, and endPos.

entries.name: physenv
entries.description: The physenv library allows you to control the physics environment created by the engine, and lets you modify constants such as gravity and maximum velocity.

entries.name: AddSurfaceData
entries.description:
Adds a [material surface property](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Material_surface_properties) type to the game's physics environment.

See [util.GetSurfaceData](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/util.GetSurfaceData) for the opposite function.

The game has a limit of 128 surface properties - this includes properties loaded automatically from [surfaceproperties.txt](https://github.com/Facepunch/garrysmod/blob/master/garrysmod/scripts/surfaceproperties.txt). Due to this, there's only a small amount of open slots that can be registered with GMod's provided surfaceproperties.txt.

Does nothing on `x86-64` beta.

args.name: properties
args.description: The properties to add. Each one should include `"base"` or the game will crash due to some values being missing.

entries.name: GetAirDensity
entries.description:
Returns the air density used to calculate drag on physics objects.
		The unit is in `kg/m³`.

returns.name: airDensity
returns.description: Default value is 2.

entries.name: GetGravity
entries.description: Gets the gravitational acceleration used for physics objects in `source_unit/s^2`.

returns.description: Gravity direction and strength.

entries.name: GetLastSimulationTime
entries.description: Returns the last simulation duration of the in-game physics.

returns.description: The last simulation duration of the in-game physics in seconds

entries.name: GetPerformanceSettings
entries.description: Gets the current performance settings in table form.

returns.description: Performance settings or nil if called too early. See Structures/PhysEnvPerformanceSettings

entries.name: GetPhysicsPaused
entries.description: Returns the pause status of global physics simulation. See [physenv.SetPhysicsPaused](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/physenv.SetPhysicsPaused) for the setter.

returns.description: `true` if paused.

entries.name: GetTimeScale
entries.description: Returns the physics time scale set with [physenv.SetTimeScale](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/physenv.SetTimeScale).

returns.description: The current physics time scale.

entries.name: SetAirDensity
entries.description: Sets the air density.

args.name: airDensity
args.description: The new air density.

entries.name: SetGravity
entries.description: Sets the gravitational acceleration used for physics objects. Does not affect players.

args.name: gravAccel
args.description: The new gravity in `source_unit/s^2`.

entries.name: SetPerformanceSettings
entries.description: Sets the performance settings.

args.name: performanceSettings
args.description: The new performance settings. See Structures/PhysEnvPerformanceSettings

entries.name: SetPhysicsPaused
entries.description: Pauses or unpauses the physics simulation globally. See [physenv.GetPhysicsPaused](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/physenv.GetPhysicsPaused) for the getter.

args.name: pause
args.description: `true` to pause, `false` to unpause.

entries.name: SetTimeScale
entries.description:
Sets the time scale of the physics simulation.

This will affect serverside-only physics if called on server, and clientside-only physics if used on the client.

See [game.SetTimeScale](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/game.SetTimeScale) for a function that also affects all game logic.

The true timescale will be `phys_timescale` (`cl_phys_timescale` on client) multiplied by [physenv.GetTimeScale](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/physenv.GetTimeScale).

args.name: timeScale
args.description: The new timescale, minimum value is 0.001 and maximum is 5.

entries.name: PhysEnvPerformanceSettings

Table used by [physenv.SetPerformanceSettings](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/physenv.SetPerformanceSettings) and [physenv.GetPerformanceSettings](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/physenv.GetPerformanceSettings).

When setting the settings, omitting any key will fallback to its current value. (can be retrieved via the get function)

fields.name: LookAheadTimeObjectsVsObject
fields.description:
Maximum amount of seconds to precalculate collisions with objects.

Default value for this setting is `0.5`.

fields.name: LookAheadTimeObjectsVsWorld
fields.description:
Maximum amount of seconds to precalculate collisions with world.

Default value for this setting is `1`.

fields.name: MaxCollisionChecksPerTimestep
fields.description:
Maximum collision checks per tick.

Objects may penetrate after this many collision checks

Default value for this setting is `50000`.

fields.name: MaxCollisionsPerObjectPerTimestep
fields.description:
Maximum collision per object per tick.

Object will be frozen after this many collisions (visual hitching vs. CPU cost)

Default value for this setting is `10`.

fields.name: MaxVelocity
fields.description:
Maximum world-space speed of an object in inches per second.

Default value for this setting is `4000`.

fields.name: MaxAngularVelocity
fields.description:
Maximum world-space rotational velocity in degrees per second.

Default value for this setting is `7272.7280273438`.

fields.name: MinFrictionMass
fields.description:
Minimum mass of an object to be affected by friction.

Default value for this setting is `10`.

fields.name: MaxFrictionMass
fields.description:
Maximum mass of an object to be affected by friction.

Default value for this setting is `2500`.

entries.name: PhysicsObjectSave
entries.description:
Structure used in storing/restoring physics object attributes.
[duplicator.GenericDuplicatorFunction](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/duplicator.GenericDuplicatorFunction) and [duplicator.DoGenericPhysics](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/duplicator.DoGenericPhysics) use a table of **PhysicsObjectSave**s with the struct's index in the table being the physics object ID.

Pos and Angle are set by the following:

```
Pos, Angle = WorldToLocal(phys:GetPos(), phys:GetAngle(), Vector( 0, 0, 0 ), Angle( 0, 0, 0 ))
```

fields.name: Pos
fields.description: The entity's world position made local with Global.WorldToLocal

fields.name: Angle
fields.description: The entity's world angles made local with Global.WorldToLocal

fields.name: Frozen
fields.description: Whether the entity is moveable. Equal to (`not` PhysObj:IsMoveable)

fields.name: NoGrav
fields.description: Whether the entity's gravity is affected by gravity or not. PhysObj:IsGravityEnabled

fields.name: Sleep
fields.description: Whether the entity is dormant or not. PhysObj:IsAsleep

entries.name: PhysObj
entries.description:
This is the object returned by [Entity:GetPhysicsObject](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity:GetPhysicsObject), [Entity:GetPhysicsObjectNum](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity:GetPhysicsObjectNum) and [Vehicle:GetWheel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Vehicle:GetWheel).

It represents a physics object. An entity can have multiple physics objects (ragdolls), one physics objects (props), or none. (NPCs, non physics entities, etc.)

Physics objects are usually simulated by the physics engine and usually dictate the position of the entity, and not the other way around.

entries.name: ApplyForceCenter

entries.name: CalculateForceOffset
entries.description:
Calculates the linear and angular impulse on the object's center of mass for an offset impulse.The outputs can be used with [PhysObj:ApplyForceCenter](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PhysObj:ApplyForceCenter) and [PhysObj:ApplyTorqueCenter](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PhysObj:ApplyTorqueCenter), respectively.

**Be careful to convert the angular impulse to world frame ([PhysObj:LocalToWorldVector](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PhysObj:LocalToWorldVector)) if you are going to use it with ApplyTorqueCenter.**

args.name: impulse
args.description: The impulse acting on the object in `kg*source_unit/s`. (World frame)

args.name: position
args.description: The location of the impulse in world coordinates (`source units`)

returns.name: linearImpulse
returns.description: The calculated linear impulse on the physics object's center of mass in `kg*source_unit/s`. (World frame)

returns.name: angularImpulse
returns.description: The calculated angular impulse on the physics object's center of mass in `kg*m^2*degrees/s`. (Local frame)

entries.name: CalculateVelocityOffset
entries.description:
Calculates the linear and angular velocities on the center of mass for an offset impulse. The outputs can be directly passed to [PhysObj:AddVelocity](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PhysObj:AddVelocity) and [PhysObj:AddAngleVelocity](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PhysObj:AddAngleVelocity), respectively.

**WARNING**: This will return zero length vectors if the physics object's motion is disabled. See [PhysObj:IsMotionEnabled](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PhysObj:IsMotionEnabled).

args.name: impulse
args.description: The impulse acting on the object in `kg*source_unit/s`. (World frame)

args.name: position
args.description: The location of the impulse in world coordinates (`source units`)

returns.description: The calculated linear velocity from the impulse on the physics object's center of mass in `source_unit/s`. (World frame)
The calculated angular velocity from the impulse on the physics object's center of mass in `degrees/s`. (Local frame)

entries.name: LocalToWorld
entries.description:
Translates a vector in the physics object's local space into worldspace coordinates.

**NOTE**: Internally transforms the vector by the [PhysObj:GetPositionMatrix](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PhysObj:GetPositionMatrix).

So in GLua it approximates to:
```
local matrixWorldTransform = PhysObj:GetPositionMatrix()
local vecWorldspaced = Vector()
vecWorldspaced:Set( vecLocal )
vecWorldspaced:Mul( matrixWorldTransform )

return vecWorldspaced
```

args.name: vecLocal
args.description: A vector in the physics object's local space.

returns.description: The corresponding worldspace vector.

args.name: vecLocal
args.description: A vector in the physics object's local space.

returns.description: The resulting vector from the rotational transformation.

entries.name: Sleep
entries.description:
Makes the physics object "sleep". The physics object will no longer be moving unless it is "woken up" by either a collision with another moving object, or by [PhysObj:Wake](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PhysObj:Wake). 

This is an optimization feature of the physics engine. Normally physics objects will automatically "sleep" when not moving for a short while, to save resources, but it can be used for other purposes, for example to temporarily suspend an object mid air.

entries.name: UpdateShadow
entries.description:
Unlike [PhysObj:SetPos](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PhysObj:SetPos) and [PhysObj:SetAngles](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PhysObj:SetAngles), this allows the movement of a physobj while leaving physics interactions intact.
This is used internally by the motion controller of the Gravity Gun , the +use pickup and the Physics Gun, and entities such as the crane.

**NOTE**: This is the ideal function to move a physics shadow created with [Entity:PhysicsInitShadow](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity:PhysicsInitShadow) or [Entity:MakePhysicsObjectAShadow](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity:MakePhysicsObjectAShadow).

args.name: targetPosition
args.description: The position we should move to.

args.name: targetAngles
args.description: The angle we should rotate towards.

args.name: frameTime
args.description:
The frame time to use for this movement, can be generally filled with Global.FrameTime or ENTITY:PhysicsSimulate with the deltaTime. 

Can be set to 0 when you need to update the physics object just once.

entries.name: Wake
entries.description:
Wakes the physics object, so that it will continue to simulate physics/gravity.

See [PhysObj:Sleep](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PhysObj:Sleep) for more information.

For example, in GMod this is used in thrusters, for working out linear force for local acceleration.

**NOTE**: In contrast to [PhysObj:WorldToLocal](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PhysObj:WorldToLocal), this function doesn't translate the vector.

args.name: vec
args.description: A worldspace vector.

returns.description: The resulting vector from the rotational transformation.

entries.name: player_activate
entries.description:
Called when a player has entered the game (connected and loaded).  
			From this point you can use [Global.Player](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Global.Player)(userid) (serverside or in singleplayer).

			**NOTE**: This is called almost directly after [GM:PlayerInitialSpawn](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:PlayerInitialSpawn) in the same tick, so you could just use that hook serverside.

			**WARNING**: Just like [GM:PlayerInitialSpawn](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:PlayerInitialSpawn), players may not have finished loading when its called. See the warning in [GM:PlayerInitialSpawn](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:PlayerInitialSpawn) for more details about possible issues
