See also [Entity:ForcePlayerDrop](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity:ForcePlayerDrop).

args.name: entity
args.description: Only drop if the held entity is this entity. If left blank, drop any held entity.

entries.name: DropWeapon
entries.description: Forces the player to drop the specified weapon

args.name: weapon
args.description: Weapon to be dropped. If unset, will default to the currently equipped weapon.

args.name: target
args.description: If set, launches the weapon at given position. There is a limit to how far it is willing to throw the weapon. Overrides velocity argument.

args.name: velocity
args.description: If set and previous argument is unset, launches the weapon with given velocity. If the velocity is higher than 400, it will be clamped to 400.

entries.name: EnterVehicle
entries.description:
Force puts the player into a specified vehicle.
This **does not** bypass [GM:CanPlayerEnterVehicle](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:CanPlayerEnterVehicle).

args.name: vehicle
args.description: Vehicle the player will enter

entries.name: EquipSuit
entries.description:
Equips the player with the HEV suit.

Allows the player to zoom, walk slowly, sprint, pickup armor batteries, use the health and armor stations and also shows the HUD.
The player also emits a flatline sound on death, which can be overridden with [GM:PlayerDeathSound](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:PlayerDeathSound).

The player is automatically equipped with the suit on spawn, if you wish to stop that, use [Player:RemoveSuit](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:RemoveSuit).

args.name: playEffects
args.description: If set to `true`, play the suit glove admire animation if player is holding no weapons.

entries.name: ExitLadder
entries.description: Forces the player off the current ladder if they are on one.

entries.name: ExitVehicle
entries.description:
Forces the player to exit the vehicle if they're in one.

This function will bypass [GM:CanExitVehicle](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:CanExitVehicle). See also [GM:PlayerLeaveVehicle](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:PlayerLeaveVehicle)

entries.name: FinishMove
entries.description:
Called from [GM:FinishMove](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:FinishMove).

**WARNING**: This hook will not work if the current gamemode overrides [GM:FinishMove](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:FinishMove) and does not call this hook.


**NOTE**: This hook is run after the [drive.FinishMove](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/drive.FinishMove) has been called.

returns.description: Return true to prevent default action

entries.name: Flashlight
entries.description:
Enables/Disables the player's flashlight.

[Player:CanUseFlashlight](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:CanUseFlashlight) must be true in order for the player's flashlight to be changed.
[GM:PlayerSwitchFlashlight](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:PlayerSwitchFlashlight) can block this function.

**NOTE**: Added in [2025.11.12](https://gmod.facepunch.com/changelist/4026), the `gmod_flashlight` attachment is used as a source for the player's flashlight. In thirdperson, the playermodel and weapon worldmodel are checked; in firstperson, the viewmodel is checked. If the attachment isn't found, default engine functionality is used.

The light sprite attached to the playermodel when the flashlight is on will also follow the playermodel's `gmod_flashlight` attachment if it exists.

args.name: isOn
args.description: Turns the flashlight on/off

entries.name: FlashlightIsOn
entries.description: Returns true if the player's flashlight is on.

returns.description: Whether the player's flashlight is on.

entries.name: Frags
entries.description:
Returns the amount of frags a player has.

**NOTE**: The value will change depending on the player's kill or suicide: +1 for a kill, -1 for a suicide.

returns.description: frags

entries.name: Freeze
entries.description:
Freeze the player. Frozen players cannot move, look around, or attack. Key bindings are still called. Similar to [Player:Lock](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:Lock) but the player can still take damage.

Manages the [FL_FROZEN](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Enums/FL#FL_FROZEN) flag on the player.

args.name: frozen
args.description: Whether the player should be frozen.

entries.name: GetActiveWeapon
entries.description:
Returns the player's active weapon.

If used on a [Global.LocalPlayer](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Global.LocalPlayer)() and the player is spectating another player with `OBS_MODE_IN_EYE`, the weapon returned will be of the spectated player.

returns.description: The weapon the player currently has equipped or NULL if the player doesn't have an active weapon eg. when they're dead.

entries.name: GetActivity
entries.description: Returns the player's current activity.

returns.name: act
returns.description: The player's current activity. See Enums/ACT.

entries.name: GetAimVector
entries.description: Returns the direction that the player is aiming.

returns.description: The direction vector of players aim

entries.name: GetAllowFullRotation
entries.description: Returns true if the players' model is allowed to rotate around the pitch and roll axis.

returns.description: Allowed

entries.name: GetAllowWeaponsInVehicle
entries.description: Returns whether the player is allowed to use their weapons in a vehicle or not.

returns.description: Whether the player is allowed to use their weapons in a vehicle or not.

entries.name: GetAmmo
entries.description: Returns a table of all ammo the player has.

returns.description:
A table with the following format
* number Key - AmmoID to be used with functions like game.GetAmmoName.
* number Value - Amount of ammo the player has of this kind.

entries.name: GetAmmoCount
entries.description: Gets the amount of ammo the player has.

args.name: ammotype
args.description: The ammunition type. Can be either number ammo ID or string ammo name.

returns.description: The amount of ammo player has in reserve.

entries.name: GetAvoidPlayers
entries.description: Gets if the player will be pushed out of nocollided players.

returns.description: pushed

entries.name: GetCanWalk
entries.description: Returns true if the player is able to walk using the (default) alt key.

returns.description: AbleToWalk

entries.name: GetCanZoom
entries.description: Determines whenever the player is allowed to use the zoom functionality.

returns.description: canZoom

entries.name: GetClassID
entries.description: Returns the player's class id.

returns.description: The player's class id.

entries.name: GetCount
entries.description:
**NOTE**: This function is only available in Sandbox and its derivatives.
Gets the total amount of entities of an entity type added by [Player:AddCount](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:AddCount).

Default types:
```
balloons
buttons
cameras
dynamite
effects
emitters
hoverballs
lamps
lights
npcs
props
ragdolls
sents
thrusters
vehicles
wheels
```

args.name: type
args.description: Type to get entity count of.

args.name: minus
args.description: If specified, it will reduce the counter by this value. Works only serverside.

returns.name: count
returns.description: The returned count.

entries.name: GetCrouchedWalkSpeed
entries.description:
Returns the crouched walk speed multiplier.

See also [Player:GetWalkSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetWalkSpeed) and [Player:SetCrouchedWalkSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetCrouchedWalkSpeed).

returns.description: The crouched walk speed multiplier.

entries.name: GetCurrentCommand
entries.description:
Returns the last command which was sent by the specified player. This can only be called on the player which [Global.GetPredictionPlayer](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Global.GetPredictionPlayer)() returns.

**NOTE**: When called clientside in singleplayer during [WEAPON:Think](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/WEAPON:Think), it will return nothing as the hook is not technically predicted in that instance. See the note on the page.


This will fail in [GM:StartCommand](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:StartCommand).

returns.description: Last user commands

entries.name: GetCurrentViewOffset
entries.description:
Gets the current applied view offset, which transitions between the player's standing and ducked view offset depending on their duck state.

Do not confuse with [Player:GetViewOffset](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetViewOffset) and [Player:GetViewOffsetDucked](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetViewOffsetDucked), which always return the standing or ducked offset respectively.

returns.description: The actual view offset.

entries.name: GetDrivingEntity
entries.description: Gets the entity the player is currently driving via the [drive](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/drive) library.

returns.description: The currently driven entity, or NULL entity

entries.name: GetDrivingMode
entries.description: Returns driving mode of the player. See [Entity Driving](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity_Driving).

returns.description: The drive mode ID or 0 if player doesn't use the drive system.

entries.name: GetDuckSpeed
entries.description: Returns a player's duck speed (in seconds)

returns.description: duckspeed

entries.name: GetEntityInUse
entries.description: Returns the entity the player is currently using, like func_tank mounted turrets or +use prop pickups.

returns.description: Entity in use, or NULL entity otherwise. For +use prop pickups, this will be NULL clientside.

entries.name: GetEyeTrace
entries.description:
Returns a table with information of what the player is looking at.

The results of this function are **cached** clientside every frame.

Uses [util.GetPlayerTrace](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/util.GetPlayerTrace) internally and is therefore bound by its limits.

See also [Player:GetEyeTraceNoCursor](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetEyeTraceNoCursor).

returns.description: Trace information, see Structures/TraceResult.

entries.name: GetEyeTraceNoCursor
entries.description:
Returns the trace according to the players view direction, ignoring their mouse (holding C and moving the mouse in Sandbox).

The results of this function are **cached** clientside every frame.

Uses [util.GetPlayerTrace](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/util.GetPlayerTrace) internally and is therefore bound by its limits.

See also [Player:GetEyeTrace](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetEyeTrace).

returns.description: Trace result. See Structures/TraceResult.

entries.name: GetFlashlightColor
entries.description: Returns the color of a player's flashlight.

returns.description: Flashlight color

entries.name: GetFOV
entries.description: Returns the FOV of the player.

returns.description: Field of view as a float

entries.name: GetFriendStatus
entries.description: Returns the steam "relationship" towards the player.

returns.description: Should return one of four different things depending on their status on your friends list: "friend", "blocked", "none", "requested" or "error_nofriendid" for bots.

entries.name: GetHands
entries.description: Gets the hands entity of a player

returns.description: The hands entity if players has one

entries.name: GetHandsModel
entries.description: Called on player spawn to determine which hand model to use

returns.description: A table containing info about view model hands model to be set. See examples.

entries.name: GetHoveredWidget
entries.description: Returns the widget the player is hovering with their mouse.

returns.description: The hovered widget.

entries.name: GetHull
entries.description:
Retrieves the minimum and maximum [Vectors](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Vector) of the [Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minimum_bounding_box) used for the [Player's](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player) physics and movement [Hull Traces](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/util.TraceHull).

		See also: [Player:SetHull](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetHull), [Player:SetHullDuck](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetHullDuck), [Player:GetHullDuck](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetHullDuck)

returns.name: mins
returns.description: The hull mins, the lowest corner of the Player's bounding box.

returns.name: maxs
returns.description: The hull maxs, the highest corner of the Player's bounding box, opposite of the mins.

entries.name: GetHullDuck
entries.description:
Retrieves the minimum and maximum [Vectors](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Vector) of the [Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minimum_bounding_box) used for the [Player's](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player) physics and movement [Hull Traces](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/util.TraceHull) while they are crouching (or "Ducking").

		See also: [Player:SetHullDuck](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetHullDuck), [Player:GetHull](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetHull), [Player:SetHull](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetHull)

returns.name: mins
returns.description: The hull mins, the lowest corner of the Player's bounding box while crouching.

returns.name: maxs
returns.description: The hull maxs, the highest corner of the Player's crouching bounding box, opposite of the mins.

entries.name: GetInfo
entries.description:
Retrieves the value of a client-side [ConVar](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/ConVar). The [ConVar](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/ConVar) must have a [FCVAR_USERINFO](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Enums/FCVAR) flag for this to work.

On client this function will return value of the local player, regardless of which player the function was called on!

See [Player:GetInfoNum](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetInfoNum) for the same function that automatically converts the string to a number.

args.name: convarName
args.description: The name of the client-side ConVar.

returns.description:
The value of the ConVar. Will return empty string if the convar doesn't exist (when called on the server), or `nil` when called on client, or the convar is blacklisted, such as password convars (both realms).

The returned value is truncated to 259 bytes.

entries.name: GetInfoNum
entries.description: Retrieves the numeric value of a client-side convar, returns nil if value is not convertible to a number. The [ConVar](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/ConVar) must have a [FCVAR_USERINFO](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Enums/FCVAR) flag for this to work.

args.name: cVarName
args.description: The name of the ConVar to query the value of

args.name: default
args.description: Default value if we failed to retrieve the number.

returns.description: The value of the ConVar or the default value

entries.name: GetJumpPower
entries.description: Returns the jump power of the player

returns.description: Jump power

entries.name: GetLadderClimbSpeed
entries.description:
Returns the player's ladder climbing speed.

See [Player:GetWalkSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetWalkSpeed) for normal walking speed, [Player:GetRunSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetRunSpeed) for sprinting speed and [Player:GetSlowWalkSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetSlowWalkSpeed) for slow walking speed.

returns.name: speed
returns.description: The ladder climbing speed.

entries.name: GetLaggedMovementValue
entries.description: Returns the timescale multiplier of the player movement.

returns.description: The timescale multiplier, defaults to `1`.

entries.name: GetMaxArmor
entries.description: Returns the maximum amount of armor the player should have. Default value is 100.

returns.name: maxarmor
returns.description: The new max armor value

entries.name: GetMaxSpeed
entries.description:
Returns the player's maximum movement speed.

See also [Player:SetMaxSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetMaxSpeed), [Player:GetWalkSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetWalkSpeed) and [Player:GetRunSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetRunSpeed).

returns.description: The maximum movement speed the player can go at.

entries.name: GetName
entries.description:
Returns the player's name, this is an alias of [Player:Nick](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:Nick).



**NOTE**: This function overrides [Entity:GetName](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity:GetName) (in the Lua metatable, not in c++), keep it in mind when dealing with [ents.FindByName](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/ents.FindByName) or any engine function which requires the mapping name.

returns.description: The player's name.

entries.deprecated: Use Player:Nick.

entries.name: GetNoCollideWithTeammates
entries.description: Returns whenever the player is set not to collide with their teammates.

returns.description: noCollideWithTeammates

entries.name: GetObserverMode
entries.description: Returns the the observer mode of the player

returns.description: Observe mode of that player, see Enums/OBS_MODE.

entries.name: GetObserverTarget
entries.description:
Returns the entity the player is currently observing.

Set using [Player:SpectateEntity](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SpectateEntity).

returns.description: The entity the player is currently spectating, or Global_Variables if the player has no target.

entries.name: GetPData
entries.description:
Returns a **P**ersistent **Data** key-value pair from the SQL database. (`sv.db` when called on server, `cl.db` when called on client)

Internally uses the [sql](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/sql) library. See [util.GetPData](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/util.GetPData) for cases when the player is not currently on the server.

**NOTE**: This function internally uses [Player:SteamID64](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SteamID64), it previously utilized [Player:UniqueID](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:UniqueID) which can cause collisions (two or more players sharing the same PData entry). [Player:SetPData](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetPData) now replaces all instances of [Player:UniqueID](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:UniqueID) with [Player:SteamID64](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SteamID64) when running [Player:SetPData](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetPData)


**NOTE**: PData is not networked from servers to clients!

args.name: key
args.description: Name of the PData key

args.name: default
args.description: Default value if PData key doesn't exist.

returns.description: The data in the SQL database or the default value given.

entries.name: GetPlayerColor
entries.description:
Returns a player's character model color.

The part of the model that is colored is determined by the model's materials, and is therefore different for each model.

See [Player:GetWeaponColor](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetWeaponColor) for the accompanying function for the weapon color.

**NOTE**: Override this function clientside on any Entity (including a player) with a supported model set (such as default player models) and returned color will apply to the model. This is done via the `PlayerColor` [matproxy](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/matproxy).

returns.description: The format is `Vector(r,g,b)`, and each color component should be between 0 and 1.

entries.name: GetPlayerInfo
entries.description: Returns a table containing player information.

returns.description: A table containing player information.

entries.name: GetPreferredCarryAngles
entries.description:
Returns the preferred carry angles of an object, if any are set.

Calls [GM:GetPreferredCarryAngles](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:GetPreferredCarryAngles) with the target entity and returns the carry angles.

args.name: carryEnt
args.description: Entity to retrieve the carry angles of.

returns.description: Carry angles or nil if the entity has no preferred carry angles.

entries.name: GetPressedWidget
entries.description:
Returns the widget entity the player is using.

Having a pressed widget stops the player from firing their weapon to allow input to be passed onto the widget.

returns.description: The pressed widget.

entries.name: GetPreviousWeapon
entries.description: Returns the weapon the player previously had equipped.

returns.description:
The previous weapon of the player.

This is not guaranteed to be a weapon entity so it should be checked with [Entity:IsWeapon](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity:IsWeapon) for safety.

entries.name: GetPunchAngle
entries.description: Returns players screen punch effect angle. See [Player:ViewPunch](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:ViewPunch) and [Player:SetViewPunchAngles](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetViewPunchAngles)

returns.description: The punch angle

entries.deprecated: You should use Player:GetViewPunchAngles instead.

entries.name: GetRagdollEntity
entries.description:
Returns players death ragdoll. The ragdoll is created by [Player:CreateRagdoll](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:CreateRagdoll).
**NOTE**: Calling [Entity:GetPos](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity:GetPos) server-side with this function then will return the position where [Player:CreateRagdoll](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:CreateRagdoll) was used, as it is a hl2mp_ragdoll which is a serverside point entity that creates a clientside ragdoll for everyone (opposed to prop_ragdoll that is serverside and networks).

returns.description:
The ragdoll.

Unlike normal clientside ragdolls (`C_ClientRagdoll`), this will be a `C_HL2MPRagdoll` on the client, and `hl2mp_ragdoll` on the server.

entries.name: GetRenderAngles
entries.description: Returns the render angles for the player.

returns.description: The render angles of the player. Only **yaw** part of the angle seems to be present.

entries.name: GetRunSpeed
entries.description:
Returns the player's sprint speed.

See also [Player:SetRunSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetRunSpeed), [Player:GetWalkSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetWalkSpeed) and [Player:GetMaxSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetMaxSpeed).

returns.description: The sprint speed

entries.name: GetShootPos
entries.description:
Returns the position of a Player's view

**NOTE**: This is the same as calling [Entity:EyePos](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity:EyePos) on the player.

returns.description: The position of the player's view.

entries.name: GetSlowWalkSpeed
entries.description:
Returns the player's slow walking speed, which is activated via +WALK keybind.

See [Player:GetWalkSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetWalkSpeed) for normal walking speed, [Player:GetRunSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetRunSpeed) for sprinting speed and [Player:GetLadderClimbSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetLadderClimbSpeed) for ladder climb speed.

returns.name: speed
returns.description: The new slow walking speed.

entries.name: GetStepSize
entries.description: Returns the maximum height player can step onto.

returns.description: The maximum height player can get up onto without jumping, in hammer units.

entries.name: GetSuitPower
entries.description:
Returns the player's HEV suit power.

This will only work for the local player when used clientside.

returns.description: The current suit power.

entries.name: GetTimeoutSeconds
entries.description:
Returns the number of seconds that the player has been timing out for. You can check if a player is timing out with [Player:IsTimingOut](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:IsTimingOut).

**NOTE**: This function is relatively useless because it is tied to the value of the `sv_timeout` ConVar, which is irrelevant to the description above. [This is not considered as a bug](https://discord.com/channels/565105920414318602/567617926991970306/748970396224585738).

returns.description: Timeout seconds.

entries.name: GetTool
entries.description: Returns [TOOL](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Structures/TOOL) table of players current tool, or of the one specified.

args.name: mode
args.description: Classname of the tool to retrieve. ( Filename of the tool in gmod_tool/stools/ )

returns.description: TOOL table, or nil if the table wasn't found or the player doesn't have a tool gun.

entries.name: GetUnDuckSpeed
entries.description: Returns a player's unduck speed (in seconds)

returns.description: unduck speed

entries.name: GetUseEntity
entries.description:
Returns the entity the player would use if they would press their `+use` keybind.
	**NOTE**: Because entity physics objects usually do not exist on the client, the client's use entity will resolve to whatever the crosshair is placed on within a little less than 72 units of the player's eye position. This differs from the entity returned by the server, which has fully physical use checking. See [util.TraceHull](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/util.TraceHull).

Issue tracker: [5027](https://github.com/Facepunch/garrysmod-issues/issues/5027)

returns.name: ent
returns.description: The entity that would be used or NULL.

entries.name: GetUserGroup
entries.description: Returns the player's user group. By default, player user groups are loaded from `garrysmod/settings/users.txt`.

returns.description: The user group of the player. This will return `"user"` if player has no user group.

entries.name: GetVehicle
entries.description: Returns the vehicle the player is driving.

returns.description:
The vehicle the player is currently driving, if any.

Returns NULL entity if the player is not driving.

entries.name: GetViewEntity
entries.description:
Returns the entity the player is using to see from (such as the player itself, the camera, or another entity).

	**NOTE**: This function will not return the currently spectated entity. See [Player:GetObserverTarget](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetObserverTarget).

returns.description: The entity the player is using to see from

entries.name: GetViewModel
entries.description:
Returns the player's view model entity by the index.
Each player has 3 view models by default, but only the first one is used.

To use the other viewmodels in your SWEP, see [Entity:SetWeaponModel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity:SetWeaponModel).

**NOTE**: In the Client [realm](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/States), other players' viewmodels are not available unless they are being spectated.

args.name: index
args.description: optional index of the view model to return, can range from 0 to 2

returns.description: The view model entity

entries.name: GetViewOffset
entries.description:
Returns the view offset of the player, which equals the difference between the player's actual position and their view when standing.

See also [Player:GetViewOffsetDucked](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetViewOffsetDucked).

returns.description: New view offset, must be local vector to player's Entity:GetPos

entries.name: GetViewOffsetDucked
entries.description:
Returns the ducked view offset of the player, which equals the difference between the player's actual position and their view when ducked.

See also [Player:GetViewOffset](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetViewOffset).

returns.description: New crouching view offset, must be local vector to player's Entity:GetPos

entries.name: GetViewPunchAngles
entries.description: Returns players screen punch effect angle.

returns.description: The punch angle

entries.name: GetViewPunchVelocity
entries.description: Returns client's view punch velocity. See [Player:ViewPunch](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:ViewPunch) and [Player:SetViewPunchVelocity](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetViewPunchVelocity)

returns.name: punchVel
returns.description: The current view punch angle velocity.

entries.name: GetVoiceVolumeScale
entries.description: Returns the current voice volume scale for given player on client.

returns.description: The voice volume scale, where 0 is 0% and 1 is 100%.

entries.name: GetWalkSpeed
entries.description:
Returns the player's normal walking speed. Not sprinting, not slow walking. (+walk)

See also [Player:SetWalkSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetWalkSpeed), [Player:GetMaxSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetMaxSpeed) and [Player:GetRunSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetRunSpeed).

returns.description: The normal walking speed.

entries.name: GetWeapon
entries.description: Returns the weapon for the specified class

args.name: className
args.description: Class name of weapon

returns.description: The weapon for the specified class, or NULL ENTITY if the player does not have this weapon.

entries.name: GetWeaponColor
entries.description:
Returns a player's weapon color.

The part of the model that is colored is determined by the model itself, and is different for each model. 

See [Player:GetPlayerColor](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetPlayerColor) for the accompanying function for the player character model color.

returns.description: The format is `Vector(r,g,b)`, and each color should be between 0 and 1.

entries.name: GetWeapons
entries.description:
Returns a table of the player's weapons.
		**NOTE**: This function returns a sequential table. Prefer to loop it with [Global.ipairs](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Global.ipairs) instead of the [Global.pairs](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Global.pairs) function.

returns.description: All the weapons the player currently has.

entries.name: Give
entries.description:
Gives the player a weapon.

This function will call [GM:PlayerCanPickupWeapon](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:PlayerCanPickupWeapon). If that hook returns false, this function will do nothing.

**NOTE**: While this function is meant for weapons/pickupables only, it is **not** restricted to weapons. Any entity can be spawned using this function, including NPCs and SENTs.

args.name: weaponClassName
args.description: Class name of weapon to give the player

args.name: bNoAmmo
args.description: Set to true to not give any ammo on weapon spawn. (Reserve ammo set by DefaultClip)

returns.description: The weapon given to the player, if one was given. It will return NULL if the player already has the weapon, or the weapon entity (entity with given classname) doesn't exist.

entries.name: GiveAmmo
entries.description: Gives ammo to a player

args.name: amount
args.description: Amount of ammo

args.name: type
args.description:
Type of ammo.
This is a string for named ammo types, and a number for ammo ID.

You can find a list of default ammo types Default_Ammo_Types.

args.name: hidePopup
args.description: Hide display popup when giving the ammo

returns.description: Ammo given.

entries.name: GodDisable
entries.description: Disables god mode on the player. Removes the [FL_GODMODE](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Enums/FL#FL_GODMODE) flag from the player.

entries.name: GodEnable
entries.description: Enables god mode on the player. Adds the [FL_GODMODE](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Enums/FL#FL_GODMODE) flag to the player.

entries.name: HasGodMode
entries.description: Returns whether the player has god mode or not, contolled by [Player:GodEnable](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GodEnable) and [Player:GodDisable](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GodDisable).

returns.description: Whether the player has god mode or not.

entries.name: HasWeapon
entries.description: Returns if the player has the specified weapon

args.name: className
args.description: Class name of the weapon

returns.description: True if the player has the weapon

entries.name: Init
entries.description: Called when the class object is created

entries.name: InVehicle
entries.description: Returns if the player is in a vehicle

returns.description: Whether the player is in a vehicle.

entries.name: IPAddress
entries.description:
Returns the player's IP address and connection port in ip:port form
**NOTE**: Returns `Error!` for bots.

returns.name: ip
returns.description: The player's IP address and connection port

entries.name: IsAdmin
entries.description:
Returns whether the player is an admin or not. It will also return `true` if the player is [Player:IsSuperAdmin](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:IsSuperAdmin) by default.

Internally this is determined by [Player:IsUserGroup](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:IsUserGroup).

returns.description: True if the player is an admin or a super admin.

entries.name: IsBot
entries.description: Returns if the player is an bot or not

returns.description: `true` if the player is a bot.

entries.name: IsConnected
entries.description: Returns true from the point when the player is sending client info but not fully in the game until they disconnect.

returns.description: isConnected

entries.name: IsDrivingEntity
entries.description: Used to find out if a player is currently 'driving' an entity (by which we mean 'right click > drive' ).

returns.description: A value representing whether or not the player is 'driving' an entity.

entries.name: IsFrozen
entries.description: Returns whether the players movement is currently frozen, controlled by [Player:Freeze](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:Freeze).

returns.description: Whether the players movement is currently frozen or not.

entries.name: IsFullyAuthenticated
entries.description:
Returns whether the player identity was confirmed by the Steam network.

See also [GM:NetworkIDValidated](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:NetworkIDValidated).

returns.description:
Whether the player has been fully authenticated or not.

This will always be true for singleplayer and the listen server host.
This will always be false for bots.

entries.name: IsListenServerHost
entries.description: Returns if a player is the host of the current session.

returns.description:
`true` if the player is the listen server host, `false` otherwise.

This will always be `true` in single player, and `false` on a dedicated server.

entries.name: IsMuted
entries.description: Returns whether or not the player is voice muted locally.

returns.description: whether or not the player is muted locally.

entries.name: IsPlayingTaunt
entries.description: Returns true if the player is playing a taunt.

returns.description: Whether the player is playing a taunt.

entries.name: IsSpeaking
entries.description: Returns whenever the player is heard by the local player clientside, or if the player is speaking serverside.

returns.description: Is the player speaking or not.

entries.name: IsSprinting
entries.description:
Returns whether the player is currently sprinting or not, specifically if they are holding their sprint key and are allowed to sprint.

This will not check if the player is currently sprinting into a wall. (i.e. holding their sprint key but not moving)

returns.description: Is the player sprinting or not

entries.name: IsSuitEquipped
entries.description:
Returns whenever the player is equipped with the suit item.

This will only work for the local player when used clientside.

returns.description: Is the suit equipped or not.

entries.name: IsSuperAdmin
entries.description:
Returns whether the player is a super admin.

Internally this is determined by [Player:IsUserGroup](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:IsUserGroup). See also [Player:IsAdmin](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:IsAdmin).

returns.description: True if the player is a super admin.

entries.name: IsTimingOut
entries.description:
Returns `true` if the player is timing out (i.e. is losing connection), `false` otherwise.

A player is considered timing out when more than 4 seconds has elapsed since a network packet was received from given player.

returns.description: Whether the player is timing out.

entries.name: IsTyping
entries.description:
Returns whether the player is typing in their chat.

This may not work properly if the server uses a custom chatbox.

returns.description: Whether the player is typing in their chat or not.

entries.name: IsUserGroup
entries.description: Returns whether the player is in specified group or not. See [Player:GetUserGroup](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetUserGroup) for a way to get player's user group.

args.name: groupName
args.description: Group to check the player for.

returns.description: `true` if the player has the given user group.

entries.name: IsVoiceAudible
entries.description: Returns if the player can be heard by the local player.

returns.description: isAudible

entries.name: IsWalking
entries.description: Returns if the player currently walking. (`+walk` keybind)

returns.description: `true` if the player is currently walking.

entries.name: IsWorldClicking
entries.description: Returns whether the player is using the world clicking feature, see [Panel:SetWorldClicker](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Panel:SetWorldClicker)

returns.description: Is the player world clicking or not.

entries.name: IsWorldClickingDisabled
entries.description: Returns whether the world clicking is disabled for given player or not. See [Player:DisableWorldClicking](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:DisableWorldClicking).

returns.description: Whether the world clicking is disabled or not.

entries.name: KeyDown
entries.description: Returns whether a key is down. This is not networked to other players, meaning only the local client can see the keys they are pressing.

args.name: key
args.description: The key, see Enums/IN

returns.description: whether the key is down or not.

entries.name: KeyDownLast
entries.description: Gets whether a key was down one tick ago.

args.name: key
args.description: The key, see Enums/IN

returns.description: Is key down ?

entries.name: KeyPressed
entries.description: Gets whether a key was just pressed this tick.

args.name: key
args.description: Corresponds to an Enums/IN. You can use bit.bor here (see example 2)

returns.description: Was pressed or not

entries.name: KeyReleased
entries.description: Gets whether a key was just released this tick.

args.name: key
args.description: The key, see Enums/IN

returns.description: Was released or not

entries.name: Kick
entries.description:
Kicks the player from the server.
**NOTE**: This can not be run before the player has fully joined in. Use [game.KickID](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/game.KickID) for that.

args.name: reason
args.description:
Reason to show for disconnection.

This will be shortened to ~512 chars, though this includes the command itself and the player index so will realistically be more around ~498. It is recommended to avoid going near the limit to avoid truncation.

entries.name: Kill
entries.description: Kills a player and calls [GM:PlayerDeath](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:PlayerDeath).

entries.name: KillSilent
entries.description:
Kills a player without notifying the rest of the server.

This will call [GM:PlayerSilentDeath](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:PlayerSilentDeath) instead of [GM:PlayerDeath](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:PlayerDeath).

entries.name: LagCompensation
entries.description:
This allows the server to mitigate the lag of the player by moving back all the entities that can be lag compensated to the time the player attacked with his weapon.

This technique is most commonly used on things that hit other entities instantaneously, such as traces.

**NOTE**: [Entity:FireBullets](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity:FireBullets) calls this function internally.


Lag compensation only works for players and entities that have been enabled with [Entity:SetLagCompensated](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity:SetLagCompensated)

Despite being defined shared, it can only be used server-side in a [Predicted Hook](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/~search?q=%3Cpredicted%3EYes).

**WARNING**: This function NEEDS to be disabled after you're done with it or it will break the movement of the entities affected!


Lag compensation does not support pose parameters.

args.name: lagCompensation
args.description: The state of the lag compensation, true to enable and false to disable.

entries.name: LastHitGroup
entries.description: Returns the hitgroup where the player was last hit.

returns.description: Hitgroup, see Enums/HITGROUP

entries.name: LimitHit
entries.description:
Shows "limit hit" notification in sandbox.
**NOTE**: This function is only available in Sandbox and its derivatives.

args.name: type
args.description: Type of hit limit.

entries.name: Loadout
entries.description: Called on spawn to give the player their default loadout

entries.name: LocalEyeAngles
entries.description:
Returns the direction a player is looking as a entity/local-oriented angle.

Unlike [Entity:EyeAngles](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity:EyeAngles), this function does not include angles of the Player's [Entity:GetParent](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity:GetParent).

Does not work correctly clientside for non local players when in a vehicle. (validate: when parented in general?)

returns.description: The local eye angles.

entries.name: Lock
entries.description:
Stops a player from using any inputs, such as moving, turning, or attacking. Key binds are still called. Similar to [Player:Freeze](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:Freeze) but the player takes no damage.

Adds the [FL_FROZEN](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Enums/FL) and [FL_GODMODE](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Enums/FL) flags to the player.

entries.name: MotionSensorPos
entries.description: Returns the position of a Kinect bone.

args.name: bone
args.description: Bone to get the position of. Must be from 0 to 19.

returns.description: Position of the bone.

entries.name: Move
entries.description:
Called from [GM:Move](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:Move).

**WARNING**: This hook will not work if the current gamemode overrides [GM:Move](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:Move) and does not call this hook.


**NOTE**: This hook is run after the [drive.Move](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/drive.Move) has been called.

args.name: mv
args.description: Movement information

returns.description: Return true to prevent default action

entries.name: Name
entries.description: Returns the player's nick name. Identical to [Player:Nick](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:Nick) and [Player:GetName](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetName).

returns.description: Player's name.

entries.deprecated: Use Player:Nick.

entries.name: Nick
entries.description: Returns the player's nick name also known as display name, as it appears in Steam.

returns.description: Player's nick name

entries.name: OwnerSteamID64
entries.description:
Returns the 64-bit SteamID aka CommunityID of the Steam Account that owns the Garry's Mod license this player is using. This is useful for detecting players using Steam Family Sharing.

If player is not using Steam Family Sharing, this will return the player's actual SteamID64().

**NOTE**: This data will only be available after the player has fully authenticated with Steam. See [Player:IsFullyAuthenticated](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:IsFullyAuthenticated).

returns.description: The 64bit SteamID

entries.name: PacketLoss
entries.description: Returns the percentage of packets lost by the client. It is not networked so it only returns 0 when run clientside.

returns.description: Percentage of packets lost (0-100)

entries.name: PhysgunUnfreeze
entries.description:
Unfreezes the props player is looking at. This is essentially the same as pressing reload with the physics gun, including double press for unfreeze all.

For freezing props, use [PhysObj:EnableMotion](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/PhysObj:EnableMotion).

returns.description: Number of props unfrozen.

entries.name: PickupObject
entries.description:
This makes the player hold (same as pressing E on a small prop) given entity.

Not to be confused with picking up items like ammo or health kits.

This picks up the passed entity regardless of its mass or distance from the player.

args.name: entity
args.description: Entity to pick up.

entries.name: PickupWeapon
entries.description:
Forces the player to pickup an existing weapon entity. The player will not pick up the weapon if they already own a weapon of given type, or if the player could not normally have this weapon in their inventory.

This function **will** bypass [GM:PlayerCanPickupWeapon](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:PlayerCanPickupWeapon).

args.name: wep
args.description: The weapon to try to pick up.

args.name: ammoOnly
args.description: If set to true, the player will only attempt to pick up the ammo from the weapon. The weapon will not be picked up even if the player doesn't have a weapon of this type, and the weapon will be removed if the player picks up any ammo from it.

returns.name: result
returns.description: Whether the player succeeded in picking up the weapon or not.

entries.name: Ping
entries.description: Returns the player's ping to server.

returns.description: The player's ping.

entries.name: PlayStepSound
entries.description: Plays the correct step sound according to what the player is staying on.

args.name: volume
args.description: Volume for the sound, in range from 0 to 1

entries.name: PostDrawViewModel
entries.description: Called after the viewmodel has been drawn

args.name: viewmodel
args.description: The viewmodel

args.name: weapon
args.description: The weapon

entries.name: PreDrawViewModel
entries.description: Called before the viewmodel is drawn

args.name: viewmodel
args.description: The viewmodel

args.name: weapon
args.description: The weapon

entries.name: PrintMessage
entries.description:
Displays a message either in their chat, console, or center of the screen. See also [Global.PrintMessage](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Global.PrintMessage).

**NOTE**: When called serverside, this uses the archaic user message system (the [umsg](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/umsg)) and hence is limited to ≈250 characters.

`HUD_PRINTCENTER` will not work when this is called clientside.

args.name: type
args.description: Which type of message should be sent to the player (Enums/HUD).

args.name: message
args.description: Message to be sent to the player.

entries.name: RemoveAllAmmo
entries.description: Removes all ammo from a certain player

entries.name: RemoveAllItems
entries.description: Removes all weapons and ammo from the player.

entries.name: RemoveAmmo
entries.description: Removes the amount of the specified ammo from the player.

args.name: ammoCount
args.description: The amount of ammunition to remove.

args.name: ammoName
args.description: The name of the ammunition to remove from. This can also be a number ammoID.

entries.name: RemovePData
entries.description:
Removes a **P**ersistent **Data** key-value pair from the SQL database. (`sv.db` when called on server, `cl.db` when called on client)

Internally uses the [sql](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/sql) library. See [util.RemovePData](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/util.RemovePData) for cases when the player is not currently on the server.

**NOTE**: This function internally uses [Player:SteamID64](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SteamID64), it previously utilized [Player:UniqueID](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:UniqueID) which can cause collisions (two or more players sharing the same PData entry). [Player:SetPData](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetPData) now replaces all instances of [Player:UniqueID](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:UniqueID) with [Player:SteamID64](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SteamID64) when running [Player:SetPData](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetPData)

**NOTE**: PData is not networked from servers to clients!

args.name: key
args.description: Key to remove

returns.description: true is succeeded, false otherwise

entries.name: RemoveSuit
entries.description: Strips the player's suit item.

entries.name: ResetHull
entries.description: Resets both normal and duck hulls to their default values.

entries.name: Say
entries.description:
Forces the player to say whatever the first argument is. Works on bots too.

**NOTE**: This function ignores the default chat message cooldown

**WARNING**: The argument can only contain 126 characters. [Source SDK 2013](https://github.com/ValveSoftware/source-sdk-2013/blob/0d8dceea4310fde5706b3ce1c70609d72a38efdf/sp/src/game/server/client.cpp#L84-L86)

args.name: text
args.description: The text to force the player to say.

args.name: teamOnly
args.description: Whether to send this message to our own team only.

entries.name: ScreenFade
entries.description: Fades the screen

args.name: flags
args.description: Fade flags defined with Enums/SCREENFADE.

args.name: color
args.description: The color of the screenfade

args.name: fadeTime
args.description:
Fade(in/out) effect transition time ( From no fade to full fade and vice versa ).

This is limited to 7 bits integer part and 9 bits fractional part.

args.name: fadeHold
args.description:
Fade effect hold time.

This is limited to 7 bits integer part and 9 bits fractional part.

entries.name: SelectWeapon
entries.description:
Sets the active weapon of the player by its class name.

**WARNING**: This will switch the weapon out of prediction, causing delay on the client and [WEAPON:Deploy](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/WEAPON:Deploy) and [WEAPON:Holster](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/WEAPON:Holster) to be called out of prediction. Try using [CUserCmd:SelectWeapon](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/CUserCmd:SelectWeapon) or [input.SelectWeapon](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/input.SelectWeapon), instead.


**NOTE**: This will trigger the weapon switch event and associated animations. To switch weapons silently, use [Player:SetActiveWeapon](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetActiveWeapon).

args.name: className
args.description:
The class name of the weapon to switch to.

If the player doesn't have the specified weapon, nothing will happen. You can use Player:Give to give the weapon first.

entries.name: SendHint
entries.description:
Sends a hint to a player.

**NOTE**: This function is only available in Sandbox and its derivatives. Since this adds `#Hint_` to the beginning of each message, you should only use it with default hint messages, or those cached with [language.Add](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/language.Add). For hints with custom text, look at [notification.AddLegacy](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/notification.AddLegacy).

args.name: name
args.description: Name/class/index of the hint. You can find a list of hint names for this function List_of_Hint_Classes.

args.name: delay
args.description: Delay in seconds before showing the hint

entries.name: SendLua
entries.description:
Executes a simple Lua string on the player. 
**NOTE**: If you need to use this function more than once consider using [net](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/net) library. Send net message and make the entire code you want to execute in [net.Receive](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/net.Receive) on client.

args.name: script
args.description: The script to execute, limited to 6000 bytes.

entries.name: SetActiveWeapon
entries.description:
Sets the player's active weapon. You should use [CUserCmd:SelectWeapon](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/CUserCmd:SelectWeapon) or [Player:SelectWeapon](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SelectWeapon), instead in most cases.

This function will not trigger the weapon switch events or associated equip animations. It will bypass 
 [GM:PlayerSwitchWeapon](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:PlayerSwitchWeapon) and the currently active weapon's [WEAPON:Holster](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/WEAPON:Holster) return value.

args.name: weapon
args.description: The weapon to equip.

entries.name: SetActivity
entries.description: Sets the player's activity.

args.name: act
args.description: The new activity to set. See Enums/ACT.

entries.name: SetAllowFullRotation
entries.description: Set if the players' model is allowed to rotate around the pitch and roll axis.

args.name: Allowed
args.description: Allowed to rotate

entries.name: SetAllowWeaponsInVehicle
entries.description:
Allows player to use their weapons in a vehicle. You need to call this before entering a vehicle.

Shooting in a vehicle fires two bullets.

args.name: allow
args.description: Show we allow player to use their weapons in a vehicle or not.

entries.name: SetAmmo
entries.description: Sets the amount of the specified ammo for the player.

args.name: ammoCount
args.description: The amount of ammunition to set.

args.name: ammoType
args.description: The ammunition type. Can be either number ammo ID or string ammo name. See Default Ammo Types for default values.

entries.name: SetArmor
entries.description:
Sets the player armor value.

See [GM:HandlePlayerArmorReduction](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:HandlePlayerArmorReduction) for a hook that allows manipulating what armor does.

args.name: amount
args.description: The amount to set the armor value of the player to.

entries.name: SetAvoidPlayers
entries.description:
Pushes the player away from other players whenever the player inside another players' bounding box.

This avoidance is performed clientside by altering movement sent to server.

This applies to players within a single team. ([Player:Team](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:Team))

args.name: avoidPlayers
args.description: Whether to avoid teammates, or not.

entries.name: SetCanWalk
entries.description: Set if the player should be allowed to walk using the (default) alt key. (`+walk` keybind)

args.name: canWalk
args.description: `true` allows the player to walk.

entries.name: SetCanZoom
entries.description: Sets whether the player can use the HL2 suit zoom (`+zoom` bind) or not.

args.name: canZoom
args.description: Whether to make the player able or unable to zoom.

entries.name: SetClassID
entries.description:
**INTERNAL**: Use [player_manager.SetPlayerClass](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/player_manager.SetPlayerClass) instead.


Sets the player's class id.

args.name: classID
args.description: The class id the player is being set with.

entries.name: SetCrouchedWalkSpeed
entries.description:
Sets the crouched walk speed multiplier.

Has no effect for values above 1.

See also [Player:SetWalkSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetWalkSpeed) and [Player:GetCrouchedWalkSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetCrouchedWalkSpeed).

args.name: speed
args.description: The walk speed multiplier that crouch speed should be.

entries.name: SetCurrentViewOffset
entries.description:
Sets the **actual** view offset which equals the difference between the players actual position and their view when standing.

Do not confuse with [Player:SetViewOffset](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetViewOffset) and [Player:SetViewOffsetDucked](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetViewOffsetDucked)

args.name: viewOffset
args.description: The new view offset.

entries.name: SetDeaths
entries.description: Sets a player's death count

args.name: deathCount
args.description: Number of deaths (positive or negative)

entries.name: SetDrivingEntity
entries.description:
**INTERNAL**: This is used internally - although you're able to use it you probably shouldn't.

Sets the driving entity and driving mode.

Use [drive.PlayerStartDriving](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/drive.PlayerStartDriving) instead, see [Entity Driving](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity_Driving).

args.name: drivingEntity
args.description: The entity the player should drive.

args.name: drivingMode
args.description: The driving mode index.

entries.name: SetDSP
entries.description:
Activates a given DSP (Digital Signal Processor) effect on all sounds that the player hears. This is equivalent to setting `dsp_player` convar on the player.

		To apply a DSP effect to individual sounds, see [CSoundPatch:SetDSP](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/CSoundPatch:SetDSP)

args.name: dspEffectId
args.description:
The index of the DSP sound filter to apply.

			For a list of the available IDs and their meaning, see DSP_Presets.

args.name: fastReset
args.description:
If set to true the sound filter will be removed faster.
			
				**This only works clientside**  
				If used serverside, a message will be displayed (`SetPlayerDSP: fastReset only valid from client`) in the server console.

entries.name: SetDuckSpeed
entries.description:
Sets how quickly a player ducks.

This will not work for values >= 1.

args.name: duckSpeed
args.description: How quickly the player will duck.

entries.name: SetEyeAngles
entries.description:
Sets the local angle of the player's view (may rotate body too if angular difference is large)

**NOTE**: This function works differently when the player is in a vehicle. In that case passing `Angle(0, 90, 0)` will have the player look forward (out the windshield) and `Angle(0, 0, 0)` will have them look to the right.

args.name: angle
args.description: Angle to set the view to

entries.name: SetFlashlightColor
entries.description:
Sets the color of a player's flashlight. 
		Can be used on other players.

args.name: color
args.description: Flashlight color

entries.name: SetFOV
entries.description:
Set a player's FOV (Field Of View) over a certain amount of time.

This is meant to be called on the server or shared (for prediction), it will have no effect if called clientside only. You may want to use [GM:CalcView](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:CalcView) for that instead.

args.name: fov
args.description: the angle of perception (FOV). Set to 0 to return to default user FOV. ( Which is ranging from 75 to 100, depending on user settings )

args.name: time
args.description: the time it takes to transition to the FOV expressed in a floating point.

args.name: requester
args.description: The requester or "owner" of the zoom event. Only this entity will be able to change the player's FOV until it is set back to 0.

entries.name: SetFrags
entries.description: Sets a player's frags (kills)

args.name: fragCount
args.description: Number of frags (positive or negative)

entries.name: SetHands
entries.description:
Sets the hands entity of a player.

The hands entity is an entity introduced in Garry's Mod 13 and it's used to show the player's hands attached to the viewmodel.
This is similar to the approach used in L4D and CS:GO, for more information on how to implement this system in your gamemode visit [Using Viewmodel Hands](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Using_Viewmodel_Hands).

args.name: hands
args.description: The hands entity to set

entries.name: SetHoveredWidget
entries.description: Sets the widget that is currently hovered by the player's mouse.

args.name: widget
args.description: The widget entity that the player is hovering.

entries.name: SetHull
entries.description:
Sets the size of the [Player's](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player) [Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minimum_bounding_box) used for physics and movement [Hull Traces](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/util.TraceHull).

		See also: [Player:GetHull](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetHull), [Player:SetHullDuck](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetHullDuck), [Player:GetHullDuck](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetHullDuck)

		**NOTE**: This value is **not** replicated automatically to clients and must be manually called in both the Server and Client [Realms](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/States).

args.name: mins
args.description: The hull mins, the lowest corner of the Player's bounding box.

args.name: maxs
args.description: The hull maxs, the highest corner of the Player's bounding box, opposite of the mins.

entries.name: SetHullDuck
entries.description:
Sets the size of the [Player's](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player) [Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minimum_bounding_box) used for physics and movement [Hull Traces](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/util.TraceHull) while they are crouching (or "Ducking").

		See also: [Player:GetHullDuck](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetHullDuck), [Player:GetHull](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetHull), [Player:SetHull](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetHull)

		**NOTE**: This value is **not** replicated automatically to clients and must be manually called in both the Server and Client [Realms](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/States).

args.name: mins
args.description: The hull mins, the lowest corner of the Player's bounding box while crouching.

args.name: maxs
args.description: The hull maxs, the highest corner of the Player's crouching bounding box, opposite of the mins.

entries.name: SetJumpPower
entries.description: Sets the jump power, eg. the velocity that will be applied to the player when they jump.

args.name: jumpPower
args.description: The new jump velocity.

entries.name: SetLadderClimbSpeed
entries.description:
Sets the player's ladder climbing speed.

See [Player:SetWalkSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetWalkSpeed) for normal walking speed, [Player:SetRunSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetRunSpeed) for sprinting speed and [Player:SetSlowWalkSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetSlowWalkSpeed) for slow walking speed.

args.name: speed
args.description: The ladder climbing speed.

entries.name: SetLaggedMovementValue
entries.description:
Slows down the player movement simulation by the timescale, this is used internally in the HL2 weapon stripping sequence.

It achieves such behavior by multiplying the [Global.FrameTime](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Global.FrameTime) by the specified timescale at the start of the movement simulation and then restoring it afterwards.

**NOTE**: This is reset to 1 on spawn.

There is no weapon counterpart to this, you'll have to hardcode the multiplier in the weapon or call [Weapon:SetNextPrimaryFire](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Weapon:SetNextPrimaryFire) / [Weapon:SetNextSecondaryFire](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Weapon:SetNextSecondaryFire) manually.

args.name: timescale
args.description: The timescale multiplier.

entries.name: SetLastHitGroup
entries.description: Sets the hitgroup where the player was last hit.

args.name: hitgroup
args.description: The hitgroup to set as the "last hit", see Enums/HITGROUP.

entries.name: SetMaxArmor
entries.description: Sets the maximum amount of armor the player should have. This affects default built-in armor pickups, but not [Player:SetArmor](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetArmor).

args.name: maxarmor
args.description: The new max armor value.

entries.name: SetMaxSpeed
entries.description:
Sets the maximum speed which the player can move at.

**NOTE**: This is called automatically by the engine. If you wish to limit player speed without setting their run/sprint speeds, see [CMoveData:SetMaxClientSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/CMoveData:SetMaxClientSpeed).

args.name: walkSpeed
args.description: The maximum speed.

entries.name: SetModel
entries.description:
Called when we need to set player model from the class.

**NOTE**: This will only be called if you have not overridden [GM:PlayerSetModel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:PlayerSetModel) or call this function from it or anywhere else using [player_manager.RunClass](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/player_manager.RunClass)

entries.name: SetMuted
entries.description: Sets if the player should be voicechat muted locally.

args.name: mute
args.description: Mute or unmute.

entries.name: SetNoCollideWithTeammates
entries.description:
Sets whenever the player should not collide with their teammates, based on their [Player:Team](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:Team).

**NOTE**: This will only work for teams with ID 1 to 4 due to internal Engine limitations.

**NOTE**: This causes traces with [COLLISION_GROUP_PLAYER](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Enums/COLLISION_GROUP) to pass through players.

args.name: shouldNotCollide
args.description: `true` to disable, `false` to enable collision.

entries.name: SetNoTarget
entries.description:
Sets the players visibility towards NPCs.

Internally this toggles the [FL_NOTARGET](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Enums/FL) flag, which you can manually test for using [Entity:IsFlagSet](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity:IsFlagSet)

args.name: visibility
args.description: The visibility.

entries.name: SetObserverMode
entries.description: Sets the players observer mode. You must start the spectating first with [Player:Spectate](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:Spectate).

args.name: mode
args.description: Spectator mode using Enums/OBS_MODE.

entries.name: SetPData
entries.description:
Writes a **P**ersistent **Data** key-value pair to the SQL database. (`sv.db` when called on server, `cl.db` when called on client)

Internally uses the [sql](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/sql) library. See [util.SetPData](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/util.SetPData) for cases when the player is not currently on the server.

**NOTE**: This function internally uses [Player:SteamID64](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SteamID64), it previously utilized [Player:UniqueID](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:UniqueID) which could have caused collisions (two or more players sharing the same PData entry). [Player:SetPData](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetPData) now replaces all instances of [Player:UniqueID](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:UniqueID) with [Player:SteamID64](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SteamID64) when running [Player:SetPData](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetPData)


**NOTE**: PData is not networked from servers to clients!

args.name: key
args.description: Name of the PData key

args.name: value
args.description: Value to write to the key (**must** be an SQL valid data type, such as a string or integer)

returns.description: Whether the operation was successful or not

entries.name: SetPlayerColor
entries.description: Sets the player model's color. The part of the model that is colored is determined by the model itself, and is different for each model.

args.name: Color
args.description: This is the color to be set. The format is Vector(r, g, b), and each color should be between 0 and 1.

entries.name: SetPressedWidget
entries.description:
Sets the widget that is currently in use by the player's mouse.

Having a pressed widget stops the player from firing their weapon to allow input to be passed onto the widget.

args.name: pressedWidget
args.description: The widget the player is currently using.

entries.name: SetRenderAngles
entries.description: Sets the render angles of a player. Value set by this function is reset to player's angles ([Entity:GetAngles](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Entity:GetAngles)) right after [GM:UpdateAnimation](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:UpdateAnimation).

args.name: ang
args.description: The new render angles to set

entries.name: SetRunSpeed
entries.description:
Sets the player's sprint speed.

See also [Player:GetRunSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetRunSpeed), [Player:SetWalkSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetWalkSpeed) and [Player:SetMaxSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetMaxSpeed).
**NOTE**: player_default class run speed is: `400`

args.name: runSpeed
args.description:
The new sprint speed when `sv_friction` is below `10`. Higher `sv_friction` values will result in slower speed.

Has to be `7` or above or the player **won't** be able to move.

entries.name: SetSlowWalkSpeed
entries.description:
Sets the player's slow walking speed, which is activated via +WALK keybind.

See [Player:SetWalkSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetWalkSpeed) for normal walking speed, [Player:SetRunSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetRunSpeed) for sprinting speed and [Player:SetLadderClimbSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetLadderClimbSpeed) for ladder climb speed.

args.name: speed
args.description: The new slow walking speed.

entries.name: SetStepSize
entries.description: Sets the maximum height a player can step onto without jumping.

args.name: stepHeight
args.description: The new maximum height the player can step onto without jumping

entries.name: SetSuitPower
entries.description:
Sets the player's HEV suit power.

This will only work for the local player when used clientside.

args.name: power
args.description: The new suit power.

entries.name: SetSuppressPickupNotices
entries.description: Sets whenever to suppress the pickup notification for the player.

args.name: doSuppress
args.description: Whenever to suppress the notice or not.

entries.name: SetTeam
entries.description:
Sets the player to the chosen team. The value is networked to clients at reduced bit count (16 bits) as as a signed value, so the real range is [-32768, 32767].

Can be retrieved via [Player:Team](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:Team)

args.name: team
args.description: The team that the player is being set to.

entries.name: SetUnDuckSpeed
entries.description: Sets how quickly a player un-ducks

args.name: UnDuckSpeed
args.description: How quickly the player will un-duck

entries.name: SetupDataTables
entries.description: Setup the network table accessors.

entries.name: SetupHands
entries.description: Sets up the player's hands for the viewmodel. Calls [GM:PlayerSetHandsModel](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/GM:PlayerSetHandsModel) to determine the model. If no entity is provided, uses the player's own hands model. If spectating another entity, pass that entity to use its hands model instead.

args.name: ent
args.description: If the player is spectating an entity, this should be the entity the player is spectating, so we can use its hands model instead.

entries.name: SetUserGroup
entries.description: Sets the usergroup of the player.

args.name: groupName
args.description: The user group of the player.

entries.name: SetViewEntity
entries.description:
Attaches the players view to the position and angles of the specified entity.
	**NOTE**: By default, the view is in first person and its model will not be rendered. [Player:SetObserverMode](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetObserverMode) can be used to enable drawing of view entity.

args.name: viewEntity
args.description: The entity to attach the player view to.

entries.name: SetViewOffset
entries.description:
Sets the **desired** view offset which equals the difference between the players actual position and their view when standing.

If you want to set **actual** view offset, use [Player:SetCurrentViewOffset](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetCurrentViewOffset)

See also [Player:SetViewOffsetDucked](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetViewOffsetDucked) for **desired** view offset when crouching.

args.name: viewOffset
args.description: The new desired view offset when standing.

entries.name: SetViewOffsetDucked
entries.description:
Sets the **desired** view offset which equals the difference between the players actual position and their view when crouching.

If you want to set **actual** view offset, use [Player:SetCurrentViewOffset](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetCurrentViewOffset)

See also [Player:SetViewOffset](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetViewOffset) for **desired** view offset when standing.

args.name: viewOffset
args.description: The new desired view offset when crouching.

entries.name: SetViewPunchAngles
entries.description: Sets client's view punch angle, but not the velocity. See [Player:ViewPunch](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:ViewPunch)

args.name: punchAngle
args.description: The angle to set.

entries.name: SetViewPunchVelocity
entries.description: Sets client's view punch velocity. See [Player:ViewPunch](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:ViewPunch) and [Player:SetViewPunchAngles](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetViewPunchAngles)

args.name: punchVel
args.description: The angle velocity to set.

entries.name: SetVoiceVolumeScale
entries.description:
Sets the voice volume scale for given player on client. This value will persist from server to server, but will be reset when the game is shut down.

**NOTE**: This doesn't work on bots, their scale will always be `1`. Does not work with multiruns.

args.description: The voice volume scale, where `0` is 0% and `1` is 100%.

entries.name: SetWalkSpeed
entries.description:
Sets the player's normal walking speed. Not sprinting, not slow walking +walk.

See also [Player:SetSlowWalkSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetSlowWalkSpeed), [Player:GetWalkSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:GetWalkSpeed), [Player:SetCrouchedWalkSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetCrouchedWalkSpeed), [Player:SetMaxSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetMaxSpeed) and [Player:SetRunSpeed](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:SetRunSpeed).

Using a speed of `0` can lead to prediction errors, and can cause players to move at sv_maxvelocity

**NOTE**: `player_default` class walk speed is: `200`.

args.name: walkSpeed
args.description:
The new walk speed when `sv_friction` is below `10`. Higher `sv_friction` values will result in slower speed.

Has to be `7` or above or the player **won't** be able to move.

entries.name: SetWeaponColor
entries.description: Sets the player weapon's color. The part of the model that is colored is determined by the model itself, and is different for each model.

args.name: Color
args.description: This is the color to be set. The format is Vector(r,g,b), and each color should be between 0 and 1.

entries.name: ShouldDrawLocalPlayer
entries.description:
Returns whether the **local player's** player model will be drawn at the time the function is called.

Despite this being a method on a player object, this will always represent the state of the [local player](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Global.LocalPlayer), not of the player entity this method is used on.

returns.description: `true` if the player's playermodel is visible

entries.name: ShouldDropWeapon
entries.description:
Sets whether the player's current weapon should drop on death.

**NOTE**: This is reset on spawn to the [player class](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player_Classes)'s **DropWeaponOnDie** field by [player_manager.OnPlayerSpawn](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/player_manager.OnPlayerSpawn).

args.name: drop
args.description: Whether to drop the player's current weapon or not

args.name: lightning
args.description: Whether or not to show lightning effects around the entity

entries.name: Spawn
entries.description: Called when the player spawns

entries.name: Spectate

Starts spectate mode for given player. This will also affect the players movetype in some cases.

[Player:UnSpectate](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Player:UnSpectate) should be used to remove the player from spectate mode, or call this with `OBS_MODE_NONE`.

The player must be respawned, otherwise they will be able to walk through doors and become invincible. This will be fixed in a future update.

args.name: mode
args.description: Spectate mode, see Enums/OBS_MODE.
